title: How VR and AR are Changing Industry?
excerpt: VR and AR transform industries like healthcare, education, and manufacturing, enhanced by AI. Future trends include standalone VR, AR Cloud, and 5G advancements

body.text: Wednesday, August 14, 2024

Introduction Now, it is at this point that virtual and augmented reality technologies will bring a tectonic shift to the world of technology. State-of-the-art technologies change the way of life, working, and interacting with each other. Starting from entertainment and education to health and manufacturing, VR and AR have their marks left indelibly on too many industries to count. In this blog, we will be explaining how VR and AR are changing the game and what interesting possibilities lie ahead. Rise of immersive experiences. Virtual Reality has been here almost for the last two decades but has only really become a thing in the last few years. Its quality budget VR headsets have allowed people to be immersed in virtual environments from their couch. More than anything else, it's especially the games that have powered this growth with titles such as 'Beat Saber' and 'Job Simulator', offering levels of engagement and interaction previously unachievable. The real truth of the matter is that augmented reality has been growing in a very quiet manner, especially with the launch of AR-enabled smartphones and tablets. Games such as Pokémon Go and Harry Potter: Wizards Unite have become cultural phenomena, hereby breaking the dividing line between the physical and digital worlds. Industry-Specific Applications People normally link the use of VRs and ARs to gaming technology, but the truth is that they have other uses in many diverse industries. Here are the following examples: Healthcare: It is now used in VR therapy for anxiety disorders, PTSD, and chronic pain. The technology also allows surgeons to practice complex procedures by going through a virtual environment in medical training. On the other hand, AR is used in constructing interactive 3D models of the human body, thereby enhancing patient literacy and diagnosis. Education: VR and AR have revolutionized the learning environment. By incorporating interactive simulations and 3-D models, complex concepts from textbooks are transformed into something much more engaging. Imagine being able to transport your students to historical sites, and far-away planets, or even allowing them to dissect a virtual frog all from their desks. Manufacturing: AR singles a lot of value in this process right from product design, and prototyping, to assembly. It is also used in quality control for the efficiency of defect recognition and anomaly. Also, in training, the use of VR is seen to have significantly reduced the risks of accidents while increasing the productivity of the workers in general. E-commerce: It is used for creating AR shopping experiences, whereby consumers can see themselves in clothes virtually, view furniture in their homes, and examine products in 3D. Apart from this, VR is also being used in physical stores to create experiences in the stores themselves. AI is used in VR to make NPC interactions more realistic, thereby simulating games and activities much more. It enhances object recognition in AR to provide accurate, smoother interactions. The combination of VR, AR, and AI has also begun to give way to new applications, including but not limited to the following: Virtual Try-On: AI-powered AR used in beauty and fashion lets customers try makeup and clothes virtually. Smart Glasses: AI-driven augmented reality glasses are applied in industries such as manufacturing and logistics to provide real-time information in front of the eyes of employees working therein. Virtual Assistants: AI-led virtual reality assistants that are being applied in the health and education sectors to provide individualized support and guidance. The Future of VR and AR From here, VR and AR are moving forward, and we are all going to witness much more interesting applications working in different fields. Here are some of the trends that are most looked upon: Standalone Headsets: Improvement in the making of standalone VR headgear will help people experience VR without the use of a PC or console. AR Cloud: It will allow for more persistent, shared AR experiences in which many users can interact with the same virtual objects and environments. 5G and Edge Computing: With the rollout of 5G networks and edge computing, faster data transfer rates and lower latency would make it possible for much more complex and immersive VR and AR experiences to run. Conclusion Virtual and Augmented Reality is making a change within the industry in profoundly deeper ways: from entertainment and education to healthcare and manufacturing. With further development shortly, we can almost see the new innovative applications and use cases of both technologies. Their intersection with AI, in particular, is very promising in terms of realism, interactivity, and personalization. Instructors: Expert instructors in VR, AR, Graphics, Animation, and 3D Modeling. Hands-on training on industry-standard tools and software. Join the metaverse movement and start building a career that will form the foundation for the next generation of virtual experiences. title: Cloud Computing vs. Traditional IT: change in industry
excerpt: Cloud computing is transforming IT with scalability, innovation, and stronger security, making traditional models less feasible. IT pros must reskill them.

body.text: Friday, August 16, 2024

Introduction The last couple of years have dramatically changed the face of the IT industry, and cloud computing may be the single most powerful among them. This, therefore, poses a challenge to professionals in the area: of traditional IT or moving to cloud computing. We shall delve into what makes a difference between cloud computing and traditional IT, with industry-changing implications of each, to help you understand why this shift is important. The Rise of Cloud Computing Cloud computing has indeed changed the way organizations do IT today. It helps business organizations scale incredibly, reduces costs, and adds agility with on-demand delivery in a shared pool of computing resources. The cloud is now the default platform for many companies, and there has been an increased rate of firms using cloud technologies. The cloud gives businesses agility to rapidly stand up and tear down IT capabilities that underpin their operations and workflows. There is no longer a need to order servers, which could take weeks or months; it is now necessary to have IT administrators rack, install, and provision new resources. Compute resources can now be provisioned via software tools in mere hours or days through the cloud management console. IT is no longer a fixed cost; it becomes "temporary," shut off when the task is done. Cloud software development and "DevOps" bring speed and automation to building and deploying new code, thereby increasing developer productivity. This makes for a new culture and an organizational approach that enables more rapid software release cycles and rapid product development. The Decline of Traditional IT Traditional IT is in decline. Conventional management and deployment of the in-house computer systems, networks, and applications are no longer feasible. This model needed to be more expensive to maintain on-premises infrastructures, along with constraints on scalability and inflexibility in their operations. Game-Changing Differences What then are some things that will change in the industry with the shift from traditional information technology to cloud computing? Some of the points that describe this change have been provided below. Scalability: Probably one of the biggest features of cloud computing is the feature whereby the scaling pretty much happens instantaneously in whichever direction you want to scale. This gets done in the traditional IT scenario, but it would be done only by making huge new investments in hardware and infrastructure. Innovation: Indeed, cloud computing is giving a push to innovation in the IT industry. New technologies and services are coming out every day. Traditional IT typically spends most of its time on keeping existing systems going rather than focusing on innovation. Security: Cloud computing has increased security standards with cloud providers making huge investments in robust security. Traditional IT usually lags in following through with contemporary security risks and vulnerabilities. Implications for IT Professionals What does all this mean for an IT professional? This sea change to cloud computing is profoundly affecting the profession, in that it's rendering a broad swath of traditional IT roles irrelevant. Yet, it can equally well bring in opportunities for IT professionals to reskill themselves and be part of the rising demand for professionals with competence in cloud computing. Future of IT There is absolutely no doubt about the future of IT. Cloud computing is the way forward for everybody, companies, agencies, and individuals. Factually, as more and more users come up to rely on and trust cloud technologies, the demand for expertise in cloud computing is simply poised to grow explosively. An inability to adapt to the move of conventional IT expenditure into the cloud might leave professional IT workers behind, whereas a quick embrace of cloud computing will give them success. Conclusion The difference between cloud computing and traditional IT is not one of technology; it's one of industry-changing implications. Cloud computing is changing how organizations approach IT, and it's what IT pros must change to remain relevant. IT pros who understand the industry-shifting differences between cloud computing and traditional IT set themselves up for success in an evolving industry at breakneck speeds. Get trained by expert instructors in state-of-the-art training facilities and learn through a comprehensive curriculum that imparts skills on the very basics of cloud computing, so you're all geared up for cloud computing challenges. title: Beat Ransomware virus with the help of cyber security
excerpt: Emphasizes the importance of cybersecurity in combating ransomware, highlighting their role in raising awareness

body.text: Thursday, April 04, 2024

How can you beat Ransomware virus with the help of cyber security training programmes? Ransomware is a major threat to businesses in today's digital era. This type of Ransomware attacks involves malicious error that encrypts your personal data and demands of payment to release it. As a result, multiple companies can suffer severe consequences, such as reputational losses or financial damages. However, with the effective and accurate cybersecurity training programs, businesses can significantly reduce their vulnerability to ransomware and better protect their valuable asset Lets Understand The Ransomware Before delving deeper into the role of cybersecurity training programs in combating ransomware, it's important to understand how these attacks can work and operates. Ransomware mostly access systems through the phishing emails, malicious files, or vulnerabilities in system software’s. Once inside the network, it spreads very quickly across the system, encrypting the files and making them inaccessible to users. And then attackers asked for payment, often in cryptocurrency, in exchange for the decryption key. The Human Factor: A Critical Weakness Attackers continue to take advantage of human error, which remains a significant vulnerability. Despite advances in cybersecurity technology, human error remains a key factor in significant vulnerabilities exploited by ransomware attacks. Employees who not aware of phishing tactics or fail to follow best practices of security. Inadvertently open the door to ransomware infections. This underscores the importance of cybersecurity training programs in equipping staff with the knowledge and skills needed to recognize and mitigate potential threats. The Role of Cybersecurity Training Programs Cyber security training programs play a crucial role in strengthening an organization's defenses against ransomware attacks in several key ways: Raising Awareness: We educate employees about the various forms of ransomware threats, This also includes how they propagate and what the potential consequences of an attack are. By promoting a culture of cybersecurity awareness, organizations can empower employees to remain vigilant and identify suspicious activities or communications. Phishing Simulation Exercises: This is where employees receive a simulated phishing emails to test their ability to distinguish legitimate from malicious messages. These exercises provide valuable insights into employees' susceptibility to phishing attacks and help to identify areas for improvement. Best Practices and Protocols: Training programs teach employees best practices for maintaining strong cybersecurity hygiene, such as regularly updating software, using strong passwords, and avoiding risky online behaviors. Additionally, they outline protocols for responding to security incidents, including ransomware infections, to minimize the impact on the organization. Technical Skills Development: Beyond awareness and prevention strategies, cybersecurity training programs offer technical training to IT professionals responsible for securing networks and systems. These programs cover topics such as network security, endpoint protection, and threat intelligence, equipping IT staff with the knowledge and tools needed to detect and mitigate ransomware threats proactively. Conclusion Ransomware attacks continue to pose a significant threat to organizations worldwide, but with the right cybersecurity knowledge programs in place, businesses can strengthen their defenses and mitigate the risk of infection. To prevent ransomware threats, it is important to educate employees about them. In addition, it is important to establishing best practices for cybersecurity hygiene, and providing technical information to organizations can effectively combat ransomware and safeguard their valuable assets against malicious software and files. In today's rapidly evolving threat landscape, cybersecurity training is not only crucial but also a critical investment in the resilience and security of your organization. This article emphasizes the importance of cybersecurity training programs in combating ransomware, highlighting their role in raising awareness, fostering best practices, and equipping organizations to defend against evolving threats. They also help in making illustrations, icons, and other graphics customized in unique styles to match your brand. The combination of human creativity with AI abilities is going to revolutionize graphic design: high-quality work will now be possible to be produced more quickly and efficiently than ever before by designers. Future of AI in Graphic Design The future of graphic design is in collaboration between AI and human designers: AI handles the technical, time-consuming parts of design; and human designers focus on creative direction, storytelling, and emotion. Synergy like this will bring even more innovative and impactful designs. As more data and user feedback are digested by AI algorithms, the ability to provide more sophisticated and intuitive design solutions will continue to grow. title: Augmented Reality in Classroom!
excerpt: AR transforms Indian classrooms, making learning engaging & interactive. Benefits: higher engagement, better understanding & cost-effectiveness

body.text: Wednesday, August 21, 2024

Introduction In India, more and more schools are following the trend set by AR technology, and soon enough, this will change the traditional classroom experience. While private schools have partnered with ed-tech companies to develop customized AR content, government-aided schools, too, are making a foray into the AR way, albeit a bit slowly, driven in large part by initiatives such as NEP 2020. Notwithstanding challenges like inadequate infrastructure, lack of trained teachers, and costs, several schools in India have begun integrating the use of AR into their curriculum making complex concepts more engaging, interactive, and accessible for students. What is augmented reality? Augmented Reality is a technology that overlays information made by a computer onto the real world through the device's camera and display. Unlike Virtual Reality, which fully immerses users into an environment, AR enriches the real world with additional virtual objects, sounds, and other sensory inputs. While the technology itself dates back several decades, current improvements in mobile devices and software make it very accessible and more affordable for educational institutions. Augmented Reality in Education: Benefits Augmented Reality is changing the classroom in many ways, thereby providing several benefits associated with it for both students and teachers and the entire learning process. Among the principal advantages related to AR for education are: Higher Engagement: AR makes the learning process more interactive and engaging. Now, students can take part in various immersive experiences that will trigger their curiosity and imagination. Better Understanding: AR allows students to create 3D visualizations of complex concepts, hence developing an understanding of abstract ideas in a manner that is relatable and memorable. Personalized Learning: AR empowers educators to tailor the process of learning for individual students, depending on needs, abilities, and learning styles, promoting an all-inclusive environment that is effective in learning. Higher Accessibility: AR can reach disabled students, remote/rural students, and students who don't have access to traditional educational resources, hence bridging the gap between education opportunities. Cost-Effective: AR can reduce costs incurred by the traditional system of teaching through books, traveling, and equipment, hence enabling more people to have access to quality education. Augmented Reality in the Classroom: Examples and Applications ​ Augmented Reality finds multiple usages across subjects and age groups. Following are a few examples of AR in action: Interactive Textbooks: With AR-enabled textbooks, learning comes alive. Students can simply scan the pages to engage with interactive content, including 3D models, videos, or even quizzes. Virtual Labs: With the help of AR-based virtual labs, students can be allowed to practice experimentation and investigation in completely safe conditions, by controlling expenditure and risks. Anatomy Education: AR helps learners scrutinize the human body in 3D dimensions, making it easier for one to understand complex structures and relationships in human anatomy. Language Learning: Through interactive games, quizzes, and other exercises, AR-based language learning applications help to develop the language skills of learners in a highly engaging and fun manner. STEM Education: AR is used to teach any complex concept related to Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math with interactive, practical learning. Implementing Augmented Reality in the Classroom Though augmented reality offers a lot, it requires some serious planning, resources, and support to implement within the classroom. The steps mentioned below may be considered while doing so: Assess Your Needs : Determine how AR can enhance your teaching goals and learning objectives and evaluate what technical requirements and resources this would involve. Choose the Right Tools: Choose AR software and hardware that align with the teaching objectives and student needs and work with the technical infrastructure. Design a Content Plan: Design new or adapt relevant high-quality AR content that answers your curriculum and teaching objectives. Teachers' Training: Prepare teachers with the training and support necessary to effectively implement AR in their pedagogical processes. Monitor Progress: Continuously assess the effectiveness of AR in your classroom and make changes and improvements as needed. Overcoming Challenges and Limitations Despite the huge potential of augmented reality to cause a revolution in education, several challenges and limitations must be considered, such as: Technical Issues: Technical problems like connectivity issues or any other device compatibility issue can slow down the AR experience. Cost and Accessibility: High-end AR devices and software are not pocket-friendly and, hence quite inaccessible to some students and schools. Teacher Training: There may be a need to train teachers in using technology and help in integrating AR into their teaching. Content Quality : The extent and suitability of AR content can impact the learning experience and, as such, should be carefully curated and developed. Considering AR is taking the classroom setting to a whole new level with all sorts of benefits to learners, teachers, and the learning process, then this technology should surely revolutionize education. However, to harness it fully, certain skilled professionals must be there who can create immersive, interactive, and effective learning experiences. That's where Jetking comes in. Our Metaverse course will make you proficient in AR, VR, 3D modeling, graphics, editing, and much more, to see the bright future of education. Join Jetking today and be part of the movement that is changing the face of learning! ​Read our blog on AI in Graphic Design: The Rise of Intelligent Design Tools

title: Data Privacy in the Cloud Era: Strategies and Best Practices
excerpt: Through the adoption of resilient approaches and tailored methodologies, companies can navigate the complexities of cloud-based data storage, guaranteeing the p

body.text: Saturday, April 06, 2024

1) Introduction In the modern era of digital technology, safeguarding data privacy has emerged as a pressing issue, especially within the domain of cloud computing. With the growing dependence of businesses on cloud-based solutions for data storage and administration, the task of guaranteeing the confidentiality and security of critical data has escalated to unprecedented levels of importance. Definition of Data Privacy Data privacy involves the safeguarding of sensitive information, ensuring it remains inaccessible to unauthorized individuals. This encompasses a range of strategies and protocols designed to protect personal and confidential data from any form of exploitation or unauthorized use. Importance of Data Privacy in the Cloud Era Amidst the surge of cloud computing advancements, companies are increasingly relying on third-party cloud service providers to safeguard their data. Yet, this convenience isn't without its risks. Hence, it's imperative for businesses to craft resilient strategies and adhere to best practices in safeguarding data privacy. 2) Risks Associated with Data Privacy in the Cloud Data Breaches One of the paramount concerns entwined with safeguarding data privacy in cloud environments revolves around the looming threat of data breaches. The allure for hackers to infiltrate cloud servers, aiming to pilfer sensitive information, is ever persistent. This illicit access not only instigates financial ramifications but also casts a shadow on a business's reputation, potentially culminating in legal ramifications. Unauthorized Access Inadequately set access controls coupled with feeble authentication mechanisms can render data stored in the cloud susceptible to unauthorized entry. Cybercriminals could capitalize on security protocol gaps to breach cloud systems and jeopardize confidential information. Compliance Concerns Non-compliance with data privacy regulations poses a significant threat to businesses, potentially leading to substantial fines, legal repercussions, and tarnished brand image. Thus, prioritizing adherence to pertinent laws and regulations becomes imperative in mitigating the risks linked to data privacy within cloud environments. 3) Strategies for Data Privacy in the Cloud Encryption Securing your data with encryption before entrusting it to the cloud ensures that even if intruders manage to breach security measures, they'll be met with an impenetrable barrier. Employing robust encryption methods not only safeguards sensitive information but also fortifies it against potential breaches, bolstering overall data protection. Access Controls Employing stringent access controls is crucial to limit sensitive data access solely to authorized individuals. Leveraging Role-based Access Control (RBAC), Multifactor Authentication (MFA), and adhering to the principle of least privilege are potent strategies in thwarting unauthorized entry to data stored in the cloud. Regular Audits Regularly assessing cloud environments enables businesses to pinpoint security weaknesses and take proactive measures to address them. Through thorough security evaluations and penetration tests, organizations can fortify their defenses against potential threats and breaches, safeguarding their sensitive data and ensuring uninterrupted operations. Data Minimization Embracing a data minimization strategy means meticulously curating and preserving solely the essential data indispensable for seamless business functionality. By consciously restricting the influx of sensitive information housed within cloud servers, companies can effectively mitigate the repercussions of potential data breaches and unwarranted intrusions. 4) Best Practices for Ensuring Data Privacy Strong Password Policies Implementing robust password regulations, like mandating intricate passwords and periodic password changes, plays a pivotal role in curtailing the threat of unauthorized entry into cloud-based accounts and assets. Multi-factor Authentication Implementing multi-factor authentication enhances security by demanding users to provide diverse forms of verification before accessing cloud services. This added layer significantly decreases the risk of unauthorized access, bolstering overall protection. Employee Training Educating our team members on data privacy best practices and security protocols is crucial. By doing so, we empower them to identify and address potential threats effectively. Through regular training sessions and awareness programs, we foster a strong culture of cybersecurity within our organization, ensuring that everyone is equipped to protect our data and systems. Choosing Reliable Cloud Service Providers Choosing reliable and esteemed cloud service providers, known for their impeccable security measures and compliance, significantly bolsters the security stance of enterprises. Delving into meticulous research and scrutinizing provider certifications and security protocols stand as pivotal measures to safeguard data privacy within the cloud environment. 5) Compliance with Data Privacy Regulations GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Ensuring compliance with GDPR is non-negotiable for any organization handling the personal data of EU residents. It's imperative to strictly follow GDPR guidelines, including obtaining clear consent for data processing and establishing strong data protection measures. This not only maintains adherence to regulations but also safeguards against potential penalties. CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) lays down stringent regulations for companies gathering, managing, or trading the personal data of Californian individuals. Upholding transparency in how data is handled and offering consumers the choice to opt out are fundamental pillars of CCPA adherence. HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) Healthcare institutions and professionals entrusted with safeguarding patients' sensitive health data are obligated to adhere to HIPAA regulations, ensuring the utmost privacy and security. This entails implementing rigorous security protocols, regularly assessing potential risks, and meticulously maintaining detailed audit trails, particularly when utilizing cloud-based services. 6) Conclusion In today's digital landscape, safeguarding data privacy remains a constant struggle for businesses spanning various sectors. Through the adoption of resilient approaches and tailored methodologies, companies can navigate the complexities of cloud-based data storage, guaranteeing the protection and confidentiality of critical data. Embracing encryption protocols, stringent access management, and adherence to stringent data privacy regulations are pivotal steps in fortifying data security in an increasingly interconnected world.

title: TOP 5 Essential Skills for Aspiring Network Engineers in 202
excerpt: In 2024 network engineers need skills in cloud computing(AWS, Azure), cybersecurity, data analytics, SDN, and collaboration to manage and secure networks.

body.text: Tuesday, August 27, 2024

Introduction As we navigate the rapid curve of technological change in 2024, the demand for proficient network engineers continues to soar. With the exponential growth of digital infrastructure, firms are on the lookout for professionals who can design, implement, and manage complex networks that are secure, efficient, and scalable. Stay ahead of the curve and future-proof your career by acquiring the in-demand skills of a network engineer. The top 5 essential skills every aspiring network engineer needs to have in 2024 are discussed in this blog. This will be an all-in-one guide for both those who desire to start their careers and for those looking to improve on the ones they already possess, making it easier to thrive in this fast-changing field. Why Network Engineers Are Important in 2024 Network engineers are the ones who ensure the smooth running of an organization's digital infrastructure. These engineers design, implement and then maintain computer networks that include local area networks, wide area networks, and the Internet. The need for competent network engineers has never been so urgent, with the ever-growing interest in cloud computing, big data, and the Internet of Things. The job outlook for network and computer systems administrators is expected to grow by 5% from 2020 to 2030, faster than the average for all occupations. The main reason for this increase is that companies require much more investment in this area because of the issues of cybersecurity, cloud computing, and data analytics. Here are the top 5 essential skills any aspiring network engineer should acquire: 1. Cloud Computing Proficiency Cloud computing has greatly revolutionized the way organizations perform the function of storing, processing, and management of data. One will require depth in the cloud-based information technology service area, including how to manipulate cloud computing platforms such as Amazon Web Services, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. For a network engineer, it will be important that one is in a position to design, deploy, and manage cloud-based networks, including the migration of such networks, security, and optimization. Some of the network engineer cloud computing technical capabilities include: 1. Cloud architecture and design 2. Cloud security and compliance 3. Cloud migration and deployment 4. Cloud management and optimization 2. Cybersecurity Proficiency One of the most essential aspects of network engineering is cyber security. title: Ethical Hacking: Understanding the Principles and Techniques
excerpt: Ethical hacking, also known as, penetration testing or white-hat hacking, is a process designed to identify and rectify security vulnerabilities in computer sys

body.text: Saturday, April 06, 2024

Ethical hacking, also known as, penetration testing or white-hat hacking, is a process designed to identify and rectify security vulnerabilities in computer systems, networks, and software applications. In a time when cyber threats are pervasive, ethical hackers play a vital role in preserving digital assets and defending against malicious attacks. This article delves into the core principles, methodologies, and career opportunities within the realm of ethical hacking. Introduction to Ethical Hacking Ethical hacking entails authorized efforts to circumvent system security in order to pinpoint potential vulnerabilities that might be exploited by malicious hackers. Unlike their nefarious counterparts, ethical hackers employ their expertise to bolster security protocols and thwart unauthorized access. Fundamentals of Ethical Hacking Understanding Cybersecurity Cybersecurity involves a diverse array of methods and technologies crafted to safeguard networks, devices, and information from illicit access or harmful intrusions. Ethical hacking stands as a crucial component within cybersecurity, acting as a proactive strategy for pinpointing and neutralizing potential risks. Legal and Ethical Aspects Just like 100%, Human made unique, Ethical hackers are required to operate within legal boundaries and uphold ethical standards. This entails acquiring appropriate authorization before initiating any security evaluations and honoring the privacy and confidentiality of sensitive data. Principles of Ethical Hacking Scope and Objectives Ethical hacking engagements, which are completely human-made and unique, generally establish clear scopes and objectives. These delineate the systems and assets permitted for testing, ensuring that the testing activities stay concentrated and in line with the security objectives of the organization. Authorization and Permission To ensure absolute authenticity, prior to commencing any security evaluations, ethical hackers are required to procure explicit consent from the pertinent organization or individual overseeing the targeted systems. This practice guarantees that all assessment endeavors are executed in a lawful and morally sound manner. Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA Triad) Ensure that ethical hackers adhere strictly to the principles of confidentiality, integrity, and availability during security assessments. This entails safeguarding sensitive data, verifying the accuracy and dependability of information, and preserving the accessibility of vital systems and services. Techniques Used in Ethical Hacking Vulnerability Assessment Vulnerability assessment entails pinpointing weaknesses and potential entry points within a system or network. Ethical hackers employ specialized tools and methodologies to scan for vulnerabilities and determine the most critical areas requiring remediation. Penetration Testing Vulnerability assessment entails pinpointing weaknesses and potential entry points within a system or network. Ethical hackers employ specialized tools and methodologies to scan for vulnerabilities and determine the most critical areas requiring remediation. Social Engineering Social engineering techniques entail the manipulation of individuals to disclose confidential information or undertake actions that jeopardize security. Ethical hackers might employ social engineering tactics to assess an organization's preparedness and ability to withstand social engineering assaults. Tools of the Trade 100% Human-made unique, Ethical hackers employ an array of tools and software applications to carry out security assessments and penetration tests. These tools span from network scanners and password crackers to packet sniffers and vulnerability scanners. Skillset Required for Ethical Hacking Technical Proficiency To ensure authenticity, Ethical hackers need to cultivate a robust technical foundation encompassing computer networking, operating systems, and programming languages. Mastery of ethical hacking tools and methodologies is equally indispensable for executing thorough security evaluations. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills A fully human-crafted, unique, and ethical hacker is a proficient problem solver endowed with the skillset to scrutinize intricate systems and pinpoint potential weaknesses. Their prowess lies in their capacity to think innovatively and tailor their strategies to address diverse security hurdles. Continuous Learning In the ever-evolving realm of ethical hacking, staying ahead is paramount. Each day ushers in new threats and vulnerabilities, demanding vigilance from ethical hackers. To uphold integrity, they dedicate themselves to perpetual learning, ensuring they are well versed in the latest security trends, techniques, and best practices. Educational Paths and Certifications Formal Education vs. Self-Learning Creating a truly distinctive individual, much like the essence of 100% human creation, stems from a blend of formal education and personal pursuit. While formal schooling in computer science or cybersecurity lays a robust groundwork, a significant portion of ethical hackers emerges as self-taught experts. They refine their craft through immersive hands-on practice and dedicated independent exploration. Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) Certification Crafted entirely by human hands, the Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) certification stands as a hallmark of unparalleled uniqueness. Revered across the cybersecurity landscape, it symbolizes mastery in the art of ethical hacking. Possessing this certification not only displays expertise in ethical hacking methodologies but also serves as a prerequisite for esteemed roles within the realm of cybersecurity. Other Relevant Certifications Apart from the CEH certification, numerous other certifications cater to ethical hackers' expertise. These include the esteemed CompTIA Security+, the rigorous Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), and the prestigious Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certifications. Career Opportunities in Ethical Hacking Ethical hacking presents an array of career prospects across diverse industries such as cybersecurity consulting firms, government agencies, financial institutions, and technology companies. The demand for proficient ethical hackers is projected to steadily rise as organizations increasingly prioritize cybersecurity. Challenges and Ethical Dilemmas Balancing Security and Privacy Constructing a unique, ethical hacker-made narrative involves delicately navigating the fine line between bolstering security protocols and upholding individual privacy rights. Ethical hackers meticulously conduct security evaluations, ensuring they do not encroach upon personal freedoms or jeopardize confidential data. It is a harmonious dance between safeguarding digital landscapes and respecting the sanctity of privacy. Keeping Up with Evolving Threats In the dynamic realm of cybersecurity, the terrain is ever changing, marked by the perpetual emergence of fresh threats and novel attack avenues. It falls upon ethical hackers to remain meticulously attuned to the evolving landscape, perpetually absorbing the latest trends and advancements in security technology. By doing so, they arm themselves with the knowledge and tools essential for robust defense against the relentless evolution of threats. Conclusion Ethical hacking presents an exciting and fulfilling journey for those fascinated by cybersecurity and committed to making a constructive difference. This dynamic field offers endless possibilities for individuals passionate about safeguarding digital systems and data. By mastering the principles and methodologies of ethical hacking, aspiring professionals can set foot on a career path that promises challenges and rewards in equal measure.

title: Career in Cloud Computing or Cybersecurity
excerpt: Cloud computing or cybersecurity? Cloud computing needs skills in virtualization and storage, while cybersecurity focuses on threat protection and response.

body.text: Tuesday, August 27, 2024

Introduction The pace of change in today's technology world keeps getting quicker, and two hot careers today are related to cloud computing and cybersecurity. Both are extremely promising in terms of job prospects, making it even more confusing to choose the right one. In this article, we'll examine some of the technical differences between cloud computing and cybersecurity and the kind of skills each sphere requires, along with the career paths related to both. What is Cloud Computing? The use of computing services over the Internet is what is referred to as cloud computing. Normally, in most circumstances, the location where storing of data, as well as its processing, takes place is usually a personal computer or local server. However, cloud computing makes it possible to access and store data from remote servers through the Internet. The doing of the same will present greater flexibility, scalability, and cost cuts for oneself. What is Cybersecurity? Cybersecurity may be referred to as the process of defending systems, networks, and relevant information against unauthorized access, theft, damage, or disruption. Prevention in the domain of cybersecurity professionals describes how one should act against cyber-attacks, detect responses to incidents, and stratify to reduce risks. Key Differences Between Cloud Computing and Cybersecurity Though these two areas are, of course, connected because they are concerned with technology, there are many differences between them. The primary difference between cloud computing and cybersecurity is the difference in: Focus: the former is focused on delivering computing services over the internet, whereas the latter focuses on the protection of computer systems, networks, and private information. Skills: it would involve virtualization, storage, and networking, among others, in cloud computing, threat analysis skills, incident response, security architecture, etc., in cybersecurity. Career paths : it can be that of a cloud architect, cloud engineer, cloud consultant, security analyst, penetration tester, and chief information security officer. How, then, does one choose to follow a career path in cloud computing or cybersecurity? Below are a few factors that one may put into consideration when making some decision: Interests: Are you interested in designing and implementing cloud infrastructure, or is protecting the computer systems and networks against cyber threats your interest? Skills: Do you have experience with virtualization, storage, and networking, or with threat analysis, incident response, and security architecture? Job Outlook: Cloud computing and cybersecurity are equally in demand; however, the latter will experience a faster rise in the years to come. If you're interested in pursuing a career in cloud computing or cybersecurity, consider enrolling in Jetking's BCA in Cloud Computing and Cybersecurity program. Our programs are designed to provide you with the skills and knowledge you need to succeed in these in-demand fields. Skills Required for Cybersecurity The skills required for individuals to be able to successfully work in cloud computing, among others, include : Virtualization: VMware, VirtualBox, and Hyper-V. Storage: Fundamentals of solutions such as Amazon S3, Microsoft Azure Blob Storage, and Google Cloud Storage. Networking: Understand networking concepts: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP. Skills Required for Cybersecurity The key skills required to get into a successful career in cybersecurity are not limited to: Threat Analysis: A good grasp of tools and techniques for threat analysis inclusive but not limited to knowledge of threat intelligence and risk assessment. Incident Response: Understanding the procedures of the incident, response containment, mitigation, eradication, and recovery. Security Architecture: Understanding security architecture principles that include defense in depth and least privilege. Career Paths in Cloud Computing The cloud computing career paths are as follows: Cloud Architect: Cloud architect designs and executes the cloud infrastructure for businesses. Cloud Engineer: designs and develops cloud-based systems and applications. Cloud Consultant: Assist organizations in their cloud migration and optimization of cloud infrastructure. Career Paths in Cyber Security Some of the careers that one can invest in include: Security Analyst: Acts in response and proactively manages all the threats to information security. Penetration tester: it performs application, network, and system attacks to discover vulnerabilities. Chief Information Security Officer (CISO): A CISO is responsible for the holistic supervision of the security strategy and program in an organization. Conclusion The choice between cloud computing and cybersecurity as a career is a tough call to make, but once one considers his interests, skills, and job outlook, there are clear options for him. Explore our courses to gain the skills and knowledge you need to succeed in these in-demand fields. If you want to learn the dynamic skills of both cloud computing and cybersecurity, go Enroll in Jetking's BCA in Cloud Computing and Cybersecurity program. This course will let you have the skills needed in both these highly sought-after fields. Looking at the areas of your interest and skills, coupled with the prospect of a job in that particular area, will help you make a very informed decision about which career path to take. And with Jetking's program, you'll be well on your way to a rewarding career in tech. Moreover, look at our wide range of other courses in topics like Ethical Hacking, Red Hat Linux, and Metaverse to take your skills to new levels. title: Top 10 career options in Animation in 2024
excerpt: India's animation industry offers careers, from 2D/3D animators to VFX, game animators, and motion designers, opening creative and technical opportunities.

body.text: Wednesday, August 28, 2024

Introduction The animation industry in India is witnessing remarkable growth, fueled by swift technological advancements and an increasing demand for skilled professionals across various sectors. Animation is becoming an essential medium for storytelling and visual engagement, covering fields like entertainment, gaming, education, and advertising. For students aspiring to build a career in animation, the opportunities are both varied and exciting. In this blog, we will explore the top 10 career options in animation in the 2024 field, offering insights into the roles, responsibilities, and potential for growth in each. 1. 2D Animator: As a 2D animator, you would be responsible for creating motion in two-dimensional space with the use of vector or raster graphics. Normally, this would involve working on numerous projects ranging from TV series and web series to advertisements and even video gaming. While traditional hand-drawn techniques can still be applied, modern animators use digital software such as Adobe Animate or Toon Boom Harmony. It is a good career path for those who love to draw and have a strong visual sense of storytelling. Growth Opportunity: While 2D animation remains quite common in advertisement and online media, a steady number of jobs remain available. Specialization in more niche areas, such as educational content or mobile gaming, could further advance your career. 2. 3D Modeler: A 3D modeler is a person who makes three-dimensional objects and characters for different films, video games, or other virtual environments. This job needs an understanding of some complicated software programs such as Autodesk Maya, Blender, or ZBrush to sculpt, texture, and render the models. Precision and attention to detail are very important in this path since the 3D models should be realistic looking and attractive. Growth Opportunity: 3D modeling is in high demand in gaming, film production, and even AR/VR applications. Many animators start as modelers and move on to more advanced roles like technical directors. 3. Character animator: Character animators bring animated characters to life by crafting realistic and expressive movements. Whether they're involved in feature films, video games, or television series, they aim to ensure characters move and act in ways that feel believable and captivating. This profession demands a solid grasp of anatomy, motion, and acting to infuse emotional depth into the characters. Growth Opportunity: With the rise of animation in gaming, film, and television, character animators are increasingly sought after. Specializing in different styles of animation—such as realistic, stylized, or cartoon can open doors to diverse projects. 4. Storyboard Artist: Storyboard artists are generally responsible for the creation of a visual blueprint for a film and its script. They help in making an animation script on how the animations will be done. This role also looks into the drawing of the event still or moving images and organizing the events, movements, and angles of the camera. Effective sketching and the ability to control rhythms are very important in this section. Growth Opportunity: Storyboard artists are required in motion pictures, television, advertisement, and also for the gaming industry which is why this career can be considered versatile. Those having a good portfolio can get opportunities in big studios and production companies. 5. VFX artist: With the advancement of computer technology came the VFX or Visual Effects artists, who were responsible for VFX in movies, video games, and television. There are a lot of things that people want visual effects, from bombs to Flying cows in the sky. VFX artists combine custom models, animation and shoot elements to create compelling effects that transport the viewer into an altered reality. This role requires proficiency in software like After Effects, Nuke, or Houdini. Growth Opportunity: VFX artists are in most demand in areas such as feature film production, commercials, and video game production. A further increase in the number of streaming services and opportunities for more immersive viewing will bode well for the future of VFX. 6. Rigging Artist: Visual graphics artists and animators also have character rigging, which is a technical and creative task of building virtual bone systems known as skeletons for animated characters. They assure movement and the performance of the models in a natural sense. This is a purely technical task involving controversial areas of knowledge such as anatomy, and physics, but also technology, in the form of programs like Maya or 3ds Max. While their roles are quite different, they will spend lots of time together with animators during the production, to verify the correct performance of rigged characters. Growth Opportunity: Many film studios, video game companies, and VFX houses offer numerous employment opportunities for talented riggers as it is domain-oriented and requires a very specific skill set. Riggers tend to take up supervising positions as they develop into professionals. 7. Lighting artists: they shape the look and feel of scenes by setting up lights in animation, VFX, and gaming projects. They need to grasp how light works, understand color theory and know composition to create the visual effect they want. They often use programs like Houdini, Maya, or Unreal Engine to do this. Growth Opportunity: Films, TV shows, video games, and even building designs always need lighting artists. As more projects aim for realistic looks, the job market for talented lighting artists keeps expanding. 8. Compositing artists: Compositing artists combine many visual parts to make the final picture. They blend special effects with real footage or put together layers of 3D animation. These artists need to pay close attention to details and solve problems well. They must know how to use programs like Nuke, After Effects, or Fusion. Growth Opportunity: Compositing plays a key role in finishing films, TV shows, and ads. As computer-made images become more common in entertainment, people want compositors who have top-notch skills. 9. Game animators: they create animations for video games. They team up with game designers and programmers to make sure characters and environments react when players interact. This job needs knowledge of real-time animation methods, plus hands-on experience with game engines such as Unity or Unreal. Growth Opportunity: As the worldwide gaming industry keeps growing, there's a big need for game animators. Focusing on areas like character animation environmental animation, or even AR/VR games can open up many different career paths. 10. Motion Graphics Designer: Motion graphics designers make animated graphics for ads, websites social media, and TV broadcasts. This job involves bringing text, logos, and other design elements to life to boost visual storytelling. You need to know how to use tools like After Effects, Cinema 4D, and Illustrator to do well in this role. Growth Opportunity: Companies in digital marketing, TV production, and web design value motion graphics designers. The growing focus on video content in digital ads means there's a steady need for skilled pros in this field. Conclusion The animation field opens up many exciting job options each with its challenges and perks. You might love the art of 2D animation, or the tech skills needed for 3D modeling and special effects. The world of animation has lots to offer. If you're eager to embark on a successful career in animation, Jetking's Master in Gaming & Metaverse Design program is here to guide you. Our comprehensive programs cover everything from 3D modeling and animation to AR/VR and game design , giving you the skills and knowledge to excel in this dynamic industry. body.text: Wednesday, August 28, 2024

Introduction The world of AR and VR is evolving unimaginably fast, and India is no exception. Due to the sudden adaptation of these technologies in various industries, the demand for qualified professionals in the field of AR and VR is growing accordingly. Hence, AR VR experts in India are in great demand, and their salaries are becoming correspondingly lucrative. But how many of them ever ponder over the fact that how much an AR VR professional in India can earn per month? In this blog, we delve into the world of AR VR experts in India, learning what salary brackets they come under, understanding what job profiles each bracket holds, and what factors impact earnings. We will also discuss the growing demand for AR VR professionals in India and how you can cash in on this trend by acquiring the necessary skills and knowledge. Increasing AR VR Job Opportunities In India Demand for AR VR in the industry has been partly fueled by increased microprocessor performance, supporting the deployment of multiple technology layers and applications. As per a report from Research And Markets, the Indian AR VR market is likely to expand at a CAGR of 38.4% during 2020-25. The growth in AR VR is making India a hotbed for jobs, and companies today are willing to pay top dollar to attract the best so there is an opportunity waiting on another side of this wave that has just started. The Indian government has in the meantime started to drive growth of the AR VR industry with various initiatives. The government, for instance, has created the National Centre of Excellence for Animation (NCOE) to support professionally equipped individuals in animation and VFX. The government has also started the "Digital India" initiative, to leverage digital technologies including AR and VR across a multitude of sectors. Salary Ranges for AR VR Experts in India What can AR VR experts in India expect to earn? The salaries for AR VR professionals in India can differ significantly depending on various factors, including job role, experience, location, and the specific industry. Below are some estimated salary ranges for various AR VR job roles in India: AR VR Developer: ₹50,000 - ₹1,50,000 per month AR VR Designer: ₹40,000 - ₹1,20,000 per month AR VR Engineer: ₹60,000 - ₹2,00,000 per month AR VR Consultant: ₹80,000 - ₹3,00,000 per month AR VR Project Manager: ₹1,00,000 - ₹4,00,000 per month A report from Glassdoor indicates that the typical salary for an AR VR developer in India is approximately ₹93,000 per month. In contrast, another report by Indeed suggests that the average salary for an AR VR engineer in India is about ₹1,43,000 per month. Factors Affecting AR VR Salaries in India Various elements play a role in determining the salaries of AR VR specialists in India, such as: Experience: Professionals with more experience typically earn higher salaries. Location: AR VR experts located in major cities like Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Pune generally receive better compensation compared to those in smaller towns. Skills: Individuals with specialized skills, including 3D modeling, animation, and programming languages such as C#, Java, and Python, often command higher pay. AR VR professionals in India have the opportunity to take on various job roles, each accompanied by distinct responsibilities. Below are some typical job roles along with their associated duties: AR VR Developer : Focuses on creating AR and VR applications utilizing programming languages such as C#, Java, and Python. AR VR Designer: Tasked with crafting the user interface and enhancing the user experience for AR and VR applications. AR VR Engineer: Handles the development and execution of the technical components of AR and VR applications. AR VR Consultant: Tasked with offering expert advice to businesses on how to effectively implement AR and VR technologies. AR VR Project Manager: Charged with overseeing the development and execution of AR and VR projects. Growth Prospects The outlook for AR and VR professionals in India is promising. According to a LinkedIn report, the demand for these experts is expected to increase by 30% in the next five years. Additionally, the report notes that the average salary for AR and VR professionals is projected to rise by 20% in that timeframe. Conclusion The AR and VR industry in India is experiencing remarkable growth. With the government supporting digital technologies and an increasing demand across various sectors, professionals in AR and VR are in a prime position to benefit financially. Whether you aim to be a developer, designer, or project manager, the opportunities are abundant, along with attractive salary potential. Now is the perfect moment to acquire the necessary skills and join this exciting wave of innovation. title: What is Phishing and How to Save Your Data?
excerpt: Phishing, pronounced as

body.text: Saturday, April 27, 2024

What is Phishing and How to Save Your Data? In the fast-paced digital era we live in, the internet holds immense significance in our daily routines. However, alongside its countless benefits, lurks the looming threat of cybercrime? Among the many tactics employed by cybercriminals, phishing stands out as a particularly prevalent menace. Phishing involves deceptive schemes orchestrated by nefarious individuals aiming to trick unsuspecting users into revealing confidential information like login credentials, financial details, and personal data. In this discourse, we embark on an exploration of the intricacies of phishing - uncovering its methods, identifying its telltale signs, and crucially, equipping ourselves with strategies to shield our sensitive information from its grasp. Introduction to Phishing Phishing, pronounced as "fishing," is a deceitful cybercrime technique in which malicious individuals impersonate trustworthy entities to trick people into revealing sensitive information. This insidious method typically occurs through fake emails, text messages, or websites constructed to appear as legitimate organizations such as banks, government agencies, or well-known companies. The main goal of phishing is to exploit human psychology, persuading victims to unknowingly disclose confidential data. How Phishing Works Phishing works by exploiting vulnerabilities in human behavior rather than technical weaknesses in software. Cybercriminals employ various techniques to execute phishing attacks, including social engineering tactics and malware distribution. Some common types of phishing attacks include spear phishing, where attackers target specific individuals or organizations, and pharming, which involves redirecting users to fraudulent websites without their knowledge. Recognizing Phishing Attempts Identifying phishing attempts is essential to safeguarding oneself from falling prey to such scams. There are numerous unmistakable indicators of a phishing email, such as impersonal greetings, spelling and grammar mistakes, pressing requests for personal information, and dubious email addresses or URLs. Likewise, phishing websites frequently exhibit subtle anomalies or inconsistencies that serve as red flags indicating their fraudulent nature. Consequences of Falling for Phishing Attacks The repercussions of falling prey to phishing attacks can be grave and extend far beyond initial deception. Those ensnared may find themselves grappling with significant financial setbacks, as unauthorized transactions drain their accounts. Furthermore, the theft of their identity could result in irreparable harm to their reputation and credit standing. Additionally, the exposure of personal and sensitive data opens avenues for potential blackmail or fraudulent activities. The aftermath of such an attack can linger, leaving victims with a sense of vulnerability and distrust in the digital realm. Tips to Protect Yourself from Phishing Protecting yourself from phishing demands a blend of awareness, alertness, and proactive steps. Key pointers to shield your data encompass ensuring your software and security setups are regularly updated, crafting robust and distinct passwords for every online account, activating multi-factor authentication whenever feasible, exercising caution while accessing email attachments or clicking links, confirming the legitimacy of websites before divulging sensitive details, and educating both yourself and others about the perils and indicators of phishing assaults. Conclusion In summary, phishing presents a substantial danger to both individuals and organizations, taking advantage of human susceptibilities for nefarious ends. By grasping the mechanics of phishing, identifying its schemes, and embracing preemptive security protocols, one can adequately protect their information and reduce the likelihood of succumbing to such deceitful practices. It is crucial to stay educated, stay watchful, and collectively, we can confront the threat of phishing in today's digital landscape. Unique FAQs What should I do if I receive a suspicious email? If you receive a suspicious email, refrain from clicking on any links or downloading attachments. Instead, report the email to the appropriate authorities or contact the purported sender directly using verified contact information. Is it safe to provide personal information over the phone? It is essential to exercise caution when providing personal information over the phone, especially if you receive an unsolicited call. Verify the caller's identity and only disclose sensitive information if you are confident in the legitimacy of the request. Can antivirus software protect against phishing attacks? While antivirus software can detect and block some phishing attempts, it is not foolproof. It is crucial to complement antivirus protection with user awareness and proactive security measures to mitigate the risk of phishing attacks. How often should I change my passwords to prevent phishing? It is advisable to change your passwords regularly, ideally every few months, to minimize the risk of unauthorized access to your accounts. Additionally, ensure that your passwords are strong, unique, and not easily guessable. What should I do if I realize I have fallen for a phishing fraud? If you believe you have fallen for a phishing fraud, act quickly to mitigate the damage. Change your passwords immediately, notify your bank or financial institution if applicable, monitor your accounts for suspicious activity, and consider reporting the incident to the relevant authorities.

title: Highest Paying Remote Video Editing Jobs in India
excerpt: Remote video editing jobs in India offer exciting, well-paying opportunities across industries like YouTube, music, travel, and corporate, with high salaries.

body.text: Thursday, September 05, 2024

Introduction Video editing, since the emergence of digital media, has been one of the In-demand jobs since it gives liberty for creativity and is very well-paying. In India, the need for expert video editors has increased since companies, influencers, and brands are juggling hard to keep up with the pace of the emerging online market. And, of course, working remotely means that the video editor can work from any part of the world. The video content market is blowing up in these digital times. Be it promotional videos for brands, YouTube content, online courses, or Instagram Reels, skilled video editors are in high demand. This is not a surge required only by experienced professionals, but even entry-level editors with the right skills and tools can secure highly paid jobs. Due to the nature of work, one can edit videos while working remotely, mostly with flexible schedules, which many people prefer. The question remains, what kind of freelance remote video editing jobs pay the most? The options are endless, from creating engaging short videos to editing longer formats, including corporate presentations and music videos. This blog will throw light upon the best remote video editing jobs in India, together with the details of their roles, salaries, and essential skills needed to perform them. 1. Short video editing jobs The internet has been hijacked by short-form content, be it on Instagram or YouTube Shorts. Brands and influencers are in constant need of editors who can avail themselves of snappy, catchy, and visually interesting short videos that hook their audience fast. Average Salary: ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 per month Key Skills: Storyboarding, color grading, insertion of transitions and effects. Proficiency in software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve. 2. Editing Jobs for YouTube Videos YouTube remains one of the biggest platforms for video content, right from educational channels to entertainment and lifestyle vlogs. YouTube video editing often includes transitions, B-rolls, sound effects, and color correction; therefore, it's one of the most challenging yet rewarding remote video editing jobs. Average Salary: ₹35,000 – ₹70,000 per month Key Skills: Strong knowledge of YouTube algorithms, video pacing, graphic integration, editing for audience retention, and basic knowledge of YouTube SEO best practices. 3. Promotional Video Editing Jobs Promotional video editing involves creating advertisements for businesses, products, or events. This area of editing is very lucrative because a company can invest a fortune in a good promotional video that will help reach more customers. Average Salary: ₹40,000 – ₹80,000 per month Key Skills: Knowledge of marketing, creative storytelling, motion graphics, and concrete use of video editing techniques using After Effects and Premiere Pro. 4. Music Video Editing Jobs There needs to be a mix of creativity and technical expertise in editing music videos. A music video editor needs to have a sense of rhythm and the feel of beauty in art, besides making the visuals fall in line with every beat of the song. Average Salary: ₹40,000 – ₹90,000 per month Key Skills: Syncing visuals to audio, cutting to the beat, color grading for mood, and dynamic effects to enhance the look. 5. Online Course Video Editing Jobs With the rise of online education platforms, video editing jobs focused on creating and editing educational content have gained immense popularity. This includes organizing lectures, adding visual aids, and enhancing the overall learning experience through engaging content. Average Salary: ₹35,000 – ₹60,000 per month Key Skills: Clear storytelling, understanding of educational content structure, proficiency with video editing software, and attention to detail. 6. Travel Video Editing Jobs Travel videos always tend to be the most aesthetic pieces on social media and YouTube. Editing for travel is typically done through compilation of footage, color grading to enhance scenic views, and adding music or voiceovers. Most influencers and brands hire remote editors to make visually engaging travel vlogs and documentaries. Average Salary: ₹30,000 – ₹60,000 per month Key Skills: Visual storytelling, color grading, audio matching, and editing software. 7. Fitness Video Editing Jobs Fitness videos have personal trainers and influencers who record home workouts, gym vlogs, and other tutorials on form and technique. Editing a fitness video requires giving style to the exact movement of an exercise in just the right way to speak to all fitness enthusiasts. Average Salary: ₹30,000 – ₹55,000 per month Key Skills: Strong editing related to tutorial-based content, audio syncing, adding annotations, and knowledge about fitness trends. 8. Fashion Video Editing Jobs Fashion often makes use of videos to showcase new collections, behind-the-scenes takes, or even style tips. A fashion video editor is supposed to have a keen sense of aesthetics and the ability to create visually stunning, trendy content. Average Salary: ₹40,000 – ₹70,000 per month Key Competencies: Fashion-based storytelling, video pacing, adding music and transitions, and fashion trends. 9. Corporate Video Editing Jobs Examples of corporate videos include promotional videos, training videos, and event summaries. The kind of editing these videos usually get is formal and professional to make sure clarity and engagement are there, with the delivery of brand messaging. Average Salary: ₹35,000 – ₹75,000 per month Key Competencies: Effective communication, thorough understanding of corporate branding, professional editing styles, and knowledge about the needs of corporate videos. 10. Sport Video Editing Jobs It involves editing sports videos with dynamic action shots, making highlight reels of players, and syncing the content with fast-paced music or commentary. This dream job for editors who get into sports could show them the drama in every move of the game or a match. Average Salary: ₹35,000 – ₹70,000 per month Key Skills: Fast-paced editing, setting up audio and music, a good understanding of sporting trends, and masterful use of video editing tools. 11. Product review video editing jobs. Product review videos are the most viewed videos on YouTube and various e-commerce websites. This trend calls for a growing number of editors to create sharp, clear, and engaging videos focused on the features of the product, unboxing, and customer experiences. Average Salary: ₹30,000 – ₹55,000 per month Key Skills: Editing cleanly, communicating effectively through visuals, and being abreast of all trends that happen in e-commerce. Skills You Need for Video Editing Jobs Which Can Be Done from Home These are positions you will need to be endowed with a set of skills similar to those listed below so that you can land the position. Video Editing Skills : Adobe Premiere Pro, FCP, Davinci Resolve, After Effects among others. Storytelling : Developing raw footage into a well-told, riveting story. Attention to detail : A fully polished end product featuring smooth transitions, audio in sync, and perfect color grading. Time Management : With distributed teams, deadlines become very important because most of the communication is Independent. Conclusion Remote video editing jobs can be pretty exciting and Profitable in India for people who love to create or narrate stories. Indeed, this is the best time for budding video editors to get their feet wet in the market, considering that video content is gaining massive demand across industries. Whether it be travel vlogs, music videos, or editing corporate presentations possibilities are endless for growth and earning well too. title: Top 10 Companies Hiring Cloud Computing Experts in India
excerpt: Top companies hiring cloud experts in India include AWS, Microsoft, Google, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Tech Mahindra, Capgemini, and Accenture.

body.text: Friday, September 06, 2024

Introduction While the demand for cloud computing is observing considerable growth all over the world, India has emerged as one of the prime destinations for the cloud professional fraternity. Cloud adoption has grown steadfast across industries like information technology, finance, healthcare, and retail. Be it starting or furthering your career in cloud computing, you need to know about the companies leading in cloud talent acquisition a look into the top 10 firms hiring cloud computing experts in India, for the year 2024. 1. Amazon Web Services AWS is the world's largest cloud service provider and one of the key players in the Indian market. AWS offers all types of cloud services, from infrastructure to AI/ML, and is always in search of skilled professionals in cloud computing. The company has a huge presence in India, with offices in major cities such as Bengaluru, Mumbai, and Hyderabad. AWS can offer everything from cloud architects to DevOps engineers, which makes it a prime choice for cloud enthusiasts. 2. Microsoft Azure The adoption of Azure, Microsoft's cloud platform, has been going on aggressively across all enterprises in India. Headquartered in Hyderabad, offices also exist in Pune and Bengaluru, hiring professionals with expertise in cloud architecture, security, and cloud migration. As companies across industries move onto hybrid cloud environments, Microsoft continues its investment in expanding its workforce to meet this growing demand. 3. Google Cloud Overdrive by Google Cloud to expand its footprint, especially for key verticals like finance, healthcare, and government segments has become fast-moving. Google Cloud opened offices in locations like Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Gurgaon, hiring cloud engineers, architects, and consultants in these geographies. Its special focus on data analytics, AI, and machine learning makes it an attractive option for cloud professionals to work on cutting-edge technologies. 4. Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) TCS is among the largest IT service-providing companies in India, and cloud computing professionals are highly sought after. The company supports the migration of cloud enterprises all over the world on platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. For this company alone, jobs range from cloud engineers and cloud consultants to cloud security professionals, offering opportunities to work on several large projects. 5. Infosys Infosys is another well-settled Indian IT company with a robust cloud computing division. Infosys works in tandem with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud with the view to providing cloud transformation services. Headquartered in multiple locations within India, Infosys provides cloud strategy, architecture, migration, and cybersecurity roles. Known for employee development programs, the company is a good destination for building and growing your cloud career. 6. Wipro Wipro's cloud services are focused on helping enterprises leverage cloud technologies for innovation and efficiency. It is very well-settled in India, with offices in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, and Chennai. Wipro recruits cloud computing professionals in various designations such as cloud architects, cloud developers, and cloud security engineers. The different industry-wide involvement of Wipro makes it an attractive choice for any cloud professional who prefers diversity in job assignments. 7. HCL Technologies HCL Technologies is a leading IT outsourcing company that is increasingly focusing on cloud computing. In partnership with leading cloud providers, the company offers everything from cloud migration to multi-cloud management. Its offices across India hire experts in cloud computing for various cloud infrastructure implementation and management roles. Strong learning and development programs make HCL a great place for cloud professionals to thrive. 8. Tech Mahindra Tech Mahindra provides cloud solutions for various industry verticals, from telecom to manufacturing. The company assists clients in migrating to the cloud and with digital transformation strategies. Tech Mahindra has its headquarters in Pune but also has regional offices in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, among others. Tech Mahindra recruits cloud professionals to manage cloud infrastructure, develop cloud architecture, and take care of cloud security. With a presence on almost every continent, and working on a variety of projects, this company is an ideal choice to pursue a career in the cloud. 9. Capgemini Capgemini is an IT services company with a leading global presence in India. Its cloud practice at Capgemini focuses on enabling enterprises to leverage cloud computing for business transformation. The roles are available in cloud consulting, cloud security, and cloud infrastructure management. Capgemini offers a bounty of opportunities for cloud computing professionals across offices in cities like Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad, to bring about an impact in several industries. 10. Accenture Accenture is a leading global consulting and technology services company and has one of the large-scale cloud computing practices in India. Accenture helps enterprises across various industry verticals adopt and optimize their cloud strategies in collaboration with major cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Accenture hires cloud professionals for various positions, including Cloud Consultant, Cloud Architect, DevOps Engineer, and many others in different locations across cities like Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad. With an innovation agenda and digital transformation, Accenture will always remain a darling destination for cloud experts.
