title: Top 10 Free 3D Modeling Software for Beginners in India
excerpt: Beginners in 3D modeling can explore free tools like Blender, Tinkercad, and many more, opening doors to game development, product design, and architecture.

body.text: Monday, September 09, 2024

Introduction 3D modeling is a great field that opens up several creative possibilities, be it game environments or architectural visualizations. So, a newcomer trying to find suitable software might get perplexed, especially when you're looking for powerful but free software. Here are the top 10 free 3D modeling software for beginners in India . 1. Blender Blender is a free, open-source 3D creation suite that can support the entirety of the 3D creation pipeline, from modeling, rigging, and animation to simulation, rendering, and even video editing. It finds support in its active community of users who are continuously creating new add-ons and tutorials Thus, it is friendly enough for beginners yet has a rich set of features that advanced users may want. Available on Windows, macOS, and Linux, Blender is the ideal all-in-one tool to learn how to 3D model. 2. Tinkercad Tinkercad by Autodesk is a free browser-based 3D modeling tool, highly intuitive, and suitable even for beginners in the field of 3D design. In Tinkercad, you can easily create simple geometric shapes and then transform them into difficult models with ease. It's ideal for educators, students, and hobbyists alike. The simplicity of its use makes it approachable; the breadth of features it offers balances teaching the basics about 3D modeling without overwhelming the user with too much information. 3. SketchUp SketchUp: Accessible to anyone with a web browser, this free version is an intuitive 3D modeling tool. It boasts an easy-to-use interface that allows beginners to build simple models in no time. Whether it is architecture, interior design, or furniture modeling, SketchUp is an excellent primer in 3D design. You can also go inside its library and see how objects were constructed, as it comes with many free 3D models built by its users. 4. Meshmixer The next tool, which was developed by Autodesk, is targeted at users who want to play with 3D models. Its main purpose is to edit already created meshes, but it also has a wide range of tools that enable sculpting, creating supports for 3D printing, and hollowing objects. In turn, Meshmixer will be very good for beginners who are interested in 3D printing and preparing their models for real-world application. 5. FreeCAD FreeCAD is a free, open-source, parametric 3D modeler targeted toward mechanical engineering and product design but can easily be used for architectural purposes or other forms of engineering. If the mere basics are insufficient for some individuals, and they want to venture into more technical aspects and work on precise measurements and details, then FreeCAD is a great outlet. The greatest advantage of being a parametric model is modification by going back and adjusting dimensions easily. 6. Sculptris Sculptris is a free sculpting program from Pixologic, the creator of ZBrush. It lets a user start with a sphere of virtual clay and shape it into whatever they want with the use of different brushes and sculpting tools. This tool is perfect for those new and inclined toward organic modeling-for example, character design, or sculpting natural objects. Sculptris serves as a fine primer for digital sculpting. 7. Wings 3D Wing 3D is a free, open-source tool for 3D modeling. It's simple and easy to learn. The application provides several modeling tools that allow the creation of a wide range of shapes and structures without overwhelming a beginner with lots of details. Its simple interface and concentration on polygon modeling make it a good option for beginners in 3D design, especially in animation and game development. 8. OpenSCAD OpenSCAD differs from most 3-D modeling programs in that it uses typed input for the creation of 3-D objects. It's ideal for those proficient with programming and, in turn, want more granular control of their designs by way of scripting. Complete beginners in this field, though interested in learning to code as well, can go through this software to make their parametric designs and mathematical modeling. 9. Leopoly Leopoly is a free browser-based 3D modeling software. It targets ease of use and provides basic sculpting, painting, and modeling tools. It is ideal for students, hobbyists, and educators who seek simplicity and accessibility in creating 3D models. Its intuitiveness lets users become familiar with the very basics of 3D modeling while sharing online enables users to easily collaborate and give feedback. 10. MatterControl MatterControl is more about 3D printing software, but it also allows one to make and edit 3D models. In this regard, the software will be useful for beginners who are more interested in 3D printing than in intricate modeling, which allows modifying existing designs or making your own for printing. Conclusion The world of 3D modeling has much to offer the beginner, from Blender, which can be used for everything, to the more specialized tools of Tinkercad, SketchUp, and Sculptris. These free programs ease the entry of new people into creative fields like game development, product design, and architecture. Each program offers unique features that will be more beneficial to different skill levels and designing purposes, making it very easy for a beginner to find just what they need at the beginning of their journey. ​ If you want to take your 3D modeling skills to the next level, then Jetking's Metaverse course is your destination, with its comprehensive training in 3D modeling, AR, and VR. The course combines expert tutors with an emphasis on practical exposure that will have you honing the required skills necessary to shine in this fast-changing world of digital design. Your journey begins now with Jetking as you unlock infinite creative possibilities. ​ ​ Check Out More Blogs | Discover Our Courses

title: CBSE 10th,12th result 2024 board results are about to be rev
excerpt: CBSE board results of class 10th & 12th 2024: According to the official website the results are expected to be announced in the fourth week of May.

body.text: Monday, May 13, 2024

CBSE Class 10th,12th result 2024: CBSE 2024 board results are about to be revealed! how to check results via Web, SMS and more! CBSE board results of class 10th & 12th 2024: According to the official website the results are expected to be announced in the fourth week of May. The CBSE class 10th and class 12th results of the approximately 39 lakh students who took the board exams are being eagerly awaited. CBSE 2024 board results are predicted to be announced to the public after May 20th. Once the results are declared the qualified applicants can view them on results.cbse.nic.in or on the official website, cbse.gov.in

How can I view my CBSE 10th,12th result 2024? ​ 1. Go to the CBSE's official website. 2. Select the link for the CBSE Board Result 2024. 3. Access the account by logging in. 4. After entering the registration or roll number, press the submit button. 5. The CBSE 10th, 12th result 2024 are now available for viewing. You have the option to download and view the outcome. Students who are waiting for their results should be aware that the online grade sheets are only preliminary, and the board has recommended that students pick up their actual grade sheets from their schools. How to access the CBSE 10th,12th results 2024 via SMS: Students should prepare a text message with the format " CBSE10 " and submit it to 7738299899 to access their CBSE Class 10 result 2024 via SMS. Likewise, they need to send an SMS to the same number with the subject line " CBSE12 (roll number) (date of birth in DDMMYYYY format) (school number) (Centre number) " to receive the CBSE Class 12 result 2024. Students will receive all the information they need about their results shortly after the SMS is sent. But it's important to remember that SMS costs can change. How to apply for re-evaluation of CBSE class 10th ,12th result 2024? This is for the students who are dissatisfied with the results can submit their papers for re-evaluation process and apply for it on cbseresults.nic.in . The verification dates are expected to be announced on the same date of results which would be after 20th May. The window to apply for verification of marks will be open for five days. From the 4th day till the 8th after the CBSE boards 2024 are declared. Furthermore, the scanned hardcopy of the evaluated answer scripts will be available on the 19th day and will last till the 20th day following the date the results were announced. The window is thus going to remain open for another two days. Students can also use the official webpage to apply for a re-evaluation of their answer scripts. This facility will be accessible for two days, starting on the 24th day following the results declaration and ending on the 25th day. “ No request after the last date and to offline mode will be accepted by the board as this breaches important examination safety protocol " the board said, emphasizing the online and time-bound aspect of the application process to avail the services. Stay connected with us for more upcoming updates! https://results.cbse.nic.in/cbse-board-results-for-class-x-and-xii-are-likely-to-be-declared-after-20th-may-2024/ ​

title: Top 10 Best and Popular Hackers in India
excerpt: In this article, we will explore the top 10 popular ethical hackers in India, their contributions, and how they are safeguarding our digital environment.

body.text: Monday, September 09, 2024

Top 10 Popular Ethical Hackers in India Introduction: In today’s increasingly digital world, cybersecurity has become one of the most critical concerns for individuals, organizations, and governments alike. With data breaches, malware attacks, and online fraud becoming more frequent, ethical hackers have emerged as unsung heroes, defending our digital space. Especially in a fast-growing digital economy like India, the role of ethical hackers is becoming increasingly crucial. In this article, we will explore the top 10 popular ethical hackers in India, their contributions, and how they are safeguarding our digital environment. What is Ethical Hacking? Ethical hacking sometimes referred to, as "white-hat hacking," is the practice of legally hacking into systems to find vulnerabilities and fix them before malicious hackers can exploit them. Ethical hackers use the same techniques as cybercriminals but with the owner’s consent and for positive purposes, like testing system security. Their role is pivotal in identifying weak spots in networks, applications, or systems, helping organizations fortify their digital infrastructure. Why Ethical Hacking is Important for India? With the massive increase in internet users in India, the risk of cyber-attacks has escalated significantly. From financial institutions to government agencies and private businesses, no one is immune to these threats. Ethical hackers play a crucial role in detecting and fixing these vulnerabilities, ensuring that sensitive data remains safe. They help prevent devastating breaches that can result in both financial losses and damage to reputations. How to Become an Ethical Hacker in India? Becoming an ethical hacker requires a combination of technical skills, certifications, and experience. A strong foundation in networking, programming, and cybersecurity concepts is essential. Many ethical hackers pursue certifications such as Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP). Apart from technical expertise, problem-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and creativity are key attributes of a successful ethical hacker. Many of the individuals on our list have combined their expertise with entrepreneurial ventures, creating solutions for both India and the global market. What is Difference Between in Windows 10, 11 & 12? Top 10 Popular and Most Famous Ethical Hackers in India 1. Anand Prakash Anand Prakash is one of India’s most renowned ethical hackers, especially known for finding vulnerabilities in popular platforms like Facebook, Twitter, and Uber. He has been listed in numerous Bug Bounty programs, where companies reward hackers for identifying critical issues. Anand also founded AppSecure, a platform dedicated to helping organizations secure their applications. 2. Trishneet Arora Trishneet Arora is the CEO and founder of TAC Security, a cybersecurity company that protects corporations and governments from cyber-attacks. Despite facing early life challenges, Arora made a name for himself in the industry and now runs a successful firm that serves Fortune 500 companies. He has also authored several books on hacking and cybersecurity. 3. Rahul Tyagi Rahul Tyagi is the co-founder of Safe Security, a leading global cybersecurity company. Beyond his technical contributions, he is known for being an advocate for cybersecurity education, conducting workshops for students and professionals across India. His work has made cybersecurity more accessible to the youth, inspiring many to join the field. 4. Vivek Ramachandran Vivek Ramachandran is a pioneer in the field of Wi-Fi security and penetration testing. He is the founder of Pentester Academy, a platform dedicated to teaching hacking and security techniques. He is also known for his famous "Wi-Fi Hacking" series, which has been widely recognized in the ethical hacking community. 5. Sunny Vaghela Sunny Vaghela is a well-known cybersecurity expert and the founder of TechDefence Labs, a cybersecurity firm. His contributions range from detecting vulnerabilities in VoIP services to working with law enforcement on cybercrime cases. His work has earned him recognition as one of the top ethical hackers in India. 6. Sahil Khan Sahil Khan has built his reputation by working on cybersecurity initiatives in the financial sector, securing banks and financial institutions from cyber threats. His expertise has earned him a spot among India’s top ethical hackers, and he continues to work towards making financial systems safer. Read this also: Top 10 Differences Between iPhone and Android 7. Rohit Gautam Rohit Gautam is a prominent penetration tester and security researcher. He has gained fame for his deep knowledge of web application security and has been instrumental in helping companies find and fix critical vulnerabilities in their systems. 8. Benild Joseph Benild Joseph is a cybersecurity expert and former director of the Cyber Crime Investigation Bureau. His work has spanned from ethical hacking to preventing cybercrime, and he has played a key role in raising awareness about digital security in India. 9. Ankit Fadia Ankit Fadia became well known at a young age for his book on hacking, although his career has been marred with some controversies regarding his claims. Nevertheless, Fadia has authored numerous books and has conducted workshops, contributing to the popularization of ethical hacking in India. 10. Manan Shah Manan Shah is the founder of Avalance Global Solutions, a cybersecurity firm that provides protection to corporations worldwide. His company specializes in cyber risk management, and Shah has gained recognition for his contributions to both Indian and international cybersecurity. How These Hackers are contributing to India’s Cybersecurity? These ethical hackers have not only contributed by securing organizations but also by educating the public about the importance of cybersecurity. Their work in penetration testing, vulnerability assessments and creating cybersecurity firms has played a crucial role in making India’s digital infrastructure more secure. Challenges Faced by Ethical Hackers in India Despite their critical role, ethical hackers in India often face legal and regulatory challenges, along with the difficulty of convincing companies to invest in cybersecurity. Additionally, ethical hackers must navigate ethical dilemmas and competition, ensuring their actions remain within legal boundaries. What is The Future of Ethical Hacking in India? With the growing emphasis on digital transformation and the rising threats of cybercrime, the demand for ethical hackers in India is only set to rise. Young professionals are increasingly viewing ethical hacking as a lucrative and exciting career choice. As businesses continue to go digital, the role of ethical hackers will expand, making them integral in ensuring the security of India’s digital landscape. Emerging technologies like artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, and the Internet of Things (IoT) bring both opportunities and challenges in the field of cybersecurity. Ethical hackers will need to keep pace with these advancements to defend against newer, more sophisticated cyber threats. Moreover, with the Indian government’s push for Digital India and initiatives like Cyber Surakshit Bharat, the demand for highly skilled ethical hackers will increase across sectors like banking, finance, healthcare, and e-commerce. Read this also: Top 10 Best Low-Budget Laptops for Hacking in 2024 Conclusion: In an era where digital security is of utmost importance, ethical hackers are at the forefront of protecting both public and private systems from cyber threats. The top 10 ethical hackers in India we discussed have made significant contributions not just in safeguarding digital platforms but also in promoting awareness and educating the masses about cybersecurity. Their work demonstrates the importance of ethical hacking and how it helps maintain the integrity and security of the vast online world. With a blend of technical skills, ethical responsibility, and a passion for cybersecurity, these individuals have created a safer digital environment for India. As cyber threats continue to evolve, ethical hackers will remain the guardians of the digital space, ensuring that data breaches and cyberattacks are thwarted before they cause irreversible damage. Read this also: Top 10 free AI Tools for Video & Images creation Check Our Courses Here: Click Here FAQs: 1. What is the average salary of an ethical hacker in India? The average salary of an ethical hacker in India can vary based on experience, certifications, and the organization. On average, an entry-level ethical hacker can earn between ₹3 to ₹6 lakhs per year, while experienced professionals can earn ₹10 lakhs or more annually. Those with advanced certifications and a good track record of bug bounty programs can command even higher salaries. 2. How can someone become an ethical hacker in India? To become an ethical hacker in India, one must start by acquiring a strong foundation in networking, programming, and cybersecurity concepts. Pursuing a degree in computer science or information technology is a common path. Additionally, ethical hacking certifications such as Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), OSCP, and CISSP are highly recommended. Practical experience and continuous learning through bug bounty programs or cybersecurity competitions are also key. 3. What are the most common cyber threats in India? Some of the most common cyber threats in India include phishing attacks, ransomware, data breaches, and DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) attacks. Additionally, with the rise in digital payments and online transactions, financial fraud and identity theft have become prevalent. 4. Is ethical hacking legal in India? Yes, ethical hacking is legal in India, as long as the hacker operates within the legal framework and has permission from the system owner to test and penetrate their systems. Unauthorized hacking or breaking into systems without consent is illegal and punishable under India's Information Technology Act, 2000. 5. What certifications are recommended for ethical hackers? Some of the most recognized certifications for ethical hackers include the Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), and Certified Information Security Manager (CISM). These certifications validate a hacker's skills and enhance career prospects in the cybersecurity field. ​

title: Top 5 Cloud Storage Services for Personal Use
excerpt: Top cloud storage services- Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud, and Mega—offer diverse features. Choose based on integration, storage, security, and budget

body.text: Tuesday, September 17, 2024

Introduction Today, in this digital world, files, photos, and documents are things we manage as part of our daily routine. Cloud storage has so far offered an efficient solution by allowing users to safely store and secure their data from anywhere in the world, have access to it, and share it with whomever they choose. Be it backup for important documents freeing up space in devices or even sharing files with friends or family, cloud storage services have become irresistible. Here are Top 5 cloud storage services for personal use in 2024 1. Google Drive Google Drive is one of the best personal cloud storage options, thanks to integration with other Google services: Gmail, Google Photos, and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides). Features: . Shared Storage Free 15 GB between Google Drive, Gmail, and Google Photos . Excellent collaboration tools, offering real-time co-authoring among various authors . Compatible with multiple devices and OS, including Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS. . Advanced Search Capabilities on the Platform Based on Google's Search Engine. Pros and Cons: Pros: Generous free storage limit and user-friendly interface, so it offers strong collaboration features. Cons: Less safe regarding privacy as Google scans files for targeted ads; fewer options are there for expanding individual storage. Pricing: Other than the free 15 GB, Google One offers its users the option to buy plans starting at: . 100 GB for ₹130/month . 200 GB for ₹210/month . 2 TB for ₹650/month. With some incentives from extra discounts in the Google Store and sharing with family. 2. Dropbox Dropbox offers ease with reliability that gives an easily straightforward cloud storage experience but with features used by both individual and professional users. Features: . Offer free storage of 2 GB with the basic plan. . Smart Sync and selective sync allow the user to optimize available device space. . Offers file recovery as well as history version for up to 30 days with the free plan. . It integrates with multiple third-party apps and services; therefore, it is very versatile. Pros and Cons: Pros: It includes using an intuitive interface that integrates with all sorts of apps and provides reliable syncing capabilities. Cons: Not as much free storage as competitors, and premium plans are a little steep in price. Pricing: Dropbox offers two plans: . A Plus Plan: 2 TB for ₹750/month. . Professional Plan: 3 TB for ₹1,250/month. All plans also include additional features like Smart Sync, file recovery, etc. 3. OneDrive One of the best options is Microsoft's OneDrive if you are a Windows user; it works well with Windows and the Microsoft Office Suite. Features: . The basic plan offers free storage at 5 GB . It seamlessly works with Microsoft Office, and you will be able to get Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files in one click. . It uses Personal Vault for improved security and needs two-step verification to open sensitive files. . Accessible on all devices using Windows, macOS, iOS, or Android. Pros and Cons: Pros: The software bases its integration with Windows OS and Office Suite, which enables file versioning and is easily accessed via File Explorer. Cons: Limited free storage and not all features are free to use. Pricing: OneDrive has standalone storage plans that start with: . 100 GB for ₹140/month. . Microsoft 365 Personal: 1 TB for ₹4,199/year, . 100 GB for $1.99 per month with added premium apps of Office. 4. iCloud iCloud is pretty intuitive and seamless if users are well-integrated with the Apple ecosystem, so it is going to sync across all devices with an Apple account. Features: . It offers 5 GB of free storage for all users, which is well and good for backing up essential documents, photos, and device settings. . Always integrates seamlessly with macOS, iOS, and iPadOS, providing automatic backup for photos, files, and app data. . Shared folders along with family sharing options are provided to allow access to the storage plans of multiple users. The features of iCloud Drive, iCloud Photos, and Find My Device further strengthen the user experience. Pros and Cons Pros: This would be suitable for the Apple user as it also offers a backup solution for iPhone and iPad, besides this, several robust security measures. Cons: Less user control of the data, less functionality on a non-Apple device, and a little confusing file management on its side for new users. Pricing: . 50 GB for ₹75/month . 200 GB for ₹219/month . 2 TB for ₹749/month Apple also offers an Apple One subscription package that includes iCloud storage along with the services of Apple. 5. Mega Mega boasts itself by ensuring security and privacy and promising its users 50 GB of free storage, encrypted from end to end. Features: . 20 GB free storing facility along with a bonus sometimes with the help of achievement . Focusing on security: providing encryption of files end-to-end for all the files and objects stored and shared on the service . Sharing files through secure password protection. . Supports cross platforms like Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android. Pros and Cons: Pros: Generous free storage allocation, excellent security features, and easy-to-use options for file sharing. Cons: It's a little intricate for novice users, and its syncing speed is also not very fast compared to other services. Pricing: Paid plans in Mega are referred to as Pro: . Pro Lite: 400 GB for €4.99/month. . Pro I: 2 TB for €9.99/month. . Pro II: 8 TB for €19.99/month. . Pro III: 16 TB for €29.99/month. Each of them has higher transfer limits and additional features. Conclusion Hence, cloud storage would depend on the user's specific needs and the most comfortable ecosystem for them. For example, Google Drive will be best suited for a user who highly depends on services by Google and has much teaming-up tool use. The strength of Dropbox is simplicity coupled with rich app integration, while OneDrive will be apt for a user who is heavily invested in Windows and Office. Apple enthusiasts will find that iCloud is perfect for them, while Mega will be good for others, especially those who value security and are given generous free storage. Evaluate your needs, which may include the storage you need, its compatibility with your devices, and budget, to choose the best cloud storage service for you. Additional Tips! Security: Always consider which cloud storage service can provide you with security features such as encryption and two-factor authentication for your data. Backup Strategies: Cloud storage shall be used in conjunction with other strategies for comprehensive backup. This means that all your important files will be properly stored as well as easily accessed. File Organization: Organized files in the cloud for easy access and management. So, if you wish to know more about cloud storage, digital file management, or developing your tech skills, check out Jetking's courses on cloud computing and digital storage solutions. Knowledge is the key to the digital world! ​

title: Top 9 Emerging Technologies and Trends in IT sector
excerpt: Explore 2024's IT trends: AI, cybersecurity, cloud, blockchain, and more driving tech growth. Stay ahead with insights on emerging technologies.

body.text: Thursday, May 23, 2024

Introduction: In today's fast-paced world, where time seems to slip through our fingers like sand, staying abreast of emerging trends and technologies is like navigating a busy city during rush hour.In this whirlwind of technological innovation and social transformation, emerging trends and technologies seem like stars in the night sky, each providing a window into a future in which our imagination is our only limitation. Join us as we explore the ever-expanding realm of IT innovation, where innovation and simplicity coexist, and the only constant is change. Generative AI: ​ Artificial intelligence with generative abilities has become a potent instrument in creating content that mimics human creativity. Artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms are becoming more and more capable of creating high-quality material on their own, ranging from creating realistic photographs and videos to writing novels and creating music. In addition to easing the process of creating content, this technology creates new opportunities for innovation and imaginative thinking in a variety of sectors. 5G: The introduction of 5G technology, which offers unmatched speed, dependability, and low latency, is expected to completely transform communication. 5G offers more network capacity and higher data transfer rates, which make it possible to seamlessly incorporate advanced technologies like IoT, AR, and VR into daily applications.This revolutionary power might open new avenues and bring in a new era in industries including manufacturing, transportation, and healthcare. Virtual Reality: In recent years, VR technology has made tremendous progress, providing immersive experiences that make it difficult to distinguish between the real and virtual worlds. VR has a wide range of uses, from teaching and education to entertainment and gaming. Companies are using virtual reality (VR) to improve customer experience, mimic real-world situations, and transform remote work. This is setting the stage for a time when virtual experiences are easily incorporated into everyday life. Robotic Process Automation: Automating repetitive operations and streamlining business processes using software robots is known as robotic process automation, or RPA. RPA frees up human resources to concentrate on more value-added activities by automating manual operations like data entry, invoice processing, and customer service. In addition to increasing operational precision and efficiency, this technology lowers costs and increases scalability, making it an invaluable tool for companies trying to maintain their competitiveness in the quickly changing market of today. 3D Printing: 3D printing is completely changing how things are created and developed. 3D printing offers unmatched versatility and customization for anything from architectural models and surgical devices to experiments and custom items. The uses of this technology are spreading across several industries, such as consumer products, healthcare, aerospace, and automotive, and they are driving innovation and changing supply chains because of its continued advancement and affordability. Metaverse: A collective virtual environment that includes augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), and other immersive technologies is called the metaverse. It depicts a completely realistic virtual world where users can communicate in real-time with digital items and one another. The metaverse holds the potential to completely transform our lives in the digital age—from virtual gaming and concerts to virtual shopping and social gatherings—by creating new avenues for creativity, discovery, and teamwork. Quantum computing: This technology has the potential to resolve complicated issues that traditional computers are presently unable to handle. Quantum computers, which use the concepts of quantum physics to do calculations at ten times faster than those of conventional computers, have made significant advances possible in fields like optimization, drug discovery, and cryptography. Even though it is still in its beginning stages, quantum computing has the power to transform a wide range of sectors and spur innovation at a rate never seen before. Blockchain: Blockchain technology, best known as the underlying technology behind cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, is increasingly being adopted across various industries for its ability to provide secure, transparent, and decentralized transactions. Blockchain has a wide range of applications that can simplify procedures, lower costs, and improve communication, from supply chain management and identity verification to smart contracts and digital voting systems. Internet of Things (IoT): The network of linked sensors and gadgets that gather and share data online is referred to as the Internet of Things. IoT is changing how we interact with the world around us, from industrial machinery and infrastructural systems to wearable technology and smart household appliances. IoT has promise for process optimization, increased productivity, and the creation of new business prospects across a variety of industries through the provision of real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, and data-driven decision-making capabilities. title: Highest Paying Jobs in Game Design in India
excerpt: Top game design jobs in India: Lead Designer, Developer, Technical Artist, Art Director, Producer, Gameplay Engineer, Story Designer. Start with Jetking.

body.text: Wednesday, September 18, 2024

Introduction The gaming industry has evolved from being a nerd hobby to a large international market, opening various areas for career possibilities and exciting, well-paid jobs. For all the people enthusiastic about games and willing to make this passion their high-paying profession, game design is one of the bright areas. Let's take a closer look at the top-paying jobs in game design and what makes them so profitable. 1. A lead game designer. Role Overview: A lead game designer of a game project is responsible for determining the overall creative direction of the game. They create gameplay mechanics, storyboards, characters, and levels and have the creative team follow their ideas into reality. The role is, therefore, one of a balance between creativity and leading where every aspect of the game aligns with the original concept. Why It Pays Well: The lead game designer understands some basic principles of game design and leadership to organize and work with other departments. Ultimately, the creativity of the strategic plan will allow games that have a solid vision, look good, and are fun to play. Average Salary: ₹7,200,000 - ₹9,500,000 per year. 2. Game Developer/Programmer Role overview: These are the technical programmers/developers who provide the essential for game development. They write code that characterizes everything in a game, including the movement of characters, physics, artificial intelligence, and multiplayer functionality. Their work ensures smooth running and adherence to performance standards across diverse platforms. Why It pays well: Game development requires a good deal of technical expertise and problem-solving ability. The developer needs to ensure that the code is optimized for performance and that there are no bugs to crash the game. For this reason, developers need focus to on detail and deep knowledge of programming. Their technical problem-solving ability makes them incredibly useful. Average Salary: ₹6,000,000 - ₹10,000,000 per year. 3. Technical Artist Role overview: Technical Artists Artistic team's point of contact with the programming team, so that the visual assets integrate well within the game engine and render correctly. This position would include scripting, shader development, and interaction with 3D modeling tools to ensure the game's visual elements are working the right way. Why It Pays Well: Technical artists are highly skilled in what is essentially a niche set of skills, pairing artistic vision with technical know-how. Troubleshooting complex visual elements and optimization will be required to create high-quality graphics that do not compromise performance. It is an essential element for any game development studio. Average Salary: ₹6,400,000 - ₹9,600,000 per year. 4. Art Director of Games Role overview: The Art Director is responsible for the visual style and artistic direction of a game. He leads and coordinates a team consisting of concept artists, character designers, and environmental artists so that all visual elements are aligned with the visual vision set up at the design stage. He must maintain unity of art throughout the game. Why It pays well: because art directors often play a significant role in influencing the game's visual appeal, which is also one determining aspect of a game's success. High compensation results from the fact that managing an art team is part of their leadership responsibility and they can set up and maintain artistic standards. Average salary: ₹6,500,000 - ₹9,000,000 per year. 5. Game Producer Role overview: A Game producer oversees the entire process of creating a game, from idea to completion. The producer coordinates with teams, such as design, art, and programming, to ensure that a project will stay within its decided schedule and budget. These types are responsible also for planning the project, managing risk, and communicating with stakeholders. Why It Pays Well: The producer ensures that a game is completed within the set schedule and is delivered with a certain quality. His management skills in handling a project, where he juggles many facets of game development, are very crucial in getting a game finalized. Average Salary: ₹6,000,000 - ₹8,500,000 per year. 6. Gameplay Engineer Role overview: Game-play engineers generally tend to concentrate on the actual implementation and iteration of gameplay mechanics in a game. They work on developing interactive elements and in-game systems with character behaviors. This means that all these systems will be able to help the game provide great experiences for players. This would most often lead to close collaboration with designers to make sure that features intended to be embedded into the gameplay work as intended. Why It Pays Well: The gameplay engineers should know the game mechanisms and the way users interact with the game. Their work needs to be sound for the game to both be enjoyable and work well; thus, this job is quite valued in the development process. Average Salary: ₹5,800,000 - ₹8,000,000 per year. 7. Story Designer Role overview: The role of a story designer is to create the storyline and dialogue of the game and develop its characters. A story designer should be able to build interesting and relevant narratives that will communicate and enhance the game experience and engage more players while playing the game. Responsibilities include writing scripts, developing story arcs, and incorporating narrative into the game. Why It Pays Well: A deep storyline can add much flavor to a game and will make it come alive for its players. Thus, good writing skills and an understanding of the general principles of storytelling are what make the work of narrative designers so critical in the successful execution of any game. Average Salary: ₹5,500,000 - ₹7,500,000 per year. Conclusion Gaming is one of the most dynamic and rewarding industries, offering exciting careers in game design, development, and technical artistry. Jetking's Masters in Gaming and Metaverse Design course is specifically designed to equip students with the skills needed to excel in this vibrant field. Our program provides specialized training and hands-on project experience, making it accessible even for those without a tech background. Transform your passion into a profession with Jetking, where you can turn your love for gaming into a successful and fulfilling career. Explore Jetking's course to get you started on this exciting journey of game design and realize your worth in this dynamic domain! ​

title: Top 10 Free Video Editing Software for Beginners
excerpt: Explore top 10 free video editing tools, from DaVinci Resolve to VideoPad. Learn editing with features like VFX, audio editing, and 3D modeling all for free!

body.text: Monday, September 23, 2024

Introduction Video content has dominated communication, entertainment, and marketing post-digital era. You may shoot videos for social media, personal projects, or professional use. Improving your video editing skills will enhance the quality and impact of your content. You don't have to spend much money on software to start. In addition, many free video editing tools come with plenty of features suitable for beginners. This detailed guide walks you through the top 10 free video editing software options to get you started on your video editing journey. Why Free Video Editing Software? The great thing about free video editing software is that you can free-start one with multiple benefits for the beginner: Cost-effectiveness - Free software enables you to train and develop your skills as an editor without the cost. This is perfect when you're still starting and do not know whether you can afford to commit premium money to software products. Easy Usage - Most free video editors are beginner-friendly. They generally have friendly, user-friendly interfaces and straightforward drag-and-drop functionalities. Ideal for Learning - Free tools available can be experimented with to apply different methods of video editing and learn some basics before using something more advanced. Top 10 Free Video Editing Software for Beginners 1. DaVinci Resolve Features: DaVinci Resolve has powerful features of advanced color grading, audio postproduction, and multi-camera editing, thus making it a one-stop production tool in both the amateur and professional worlds. Pros: It's stuffed with professional-grade tools, so it will do very well for anyone looking to make the move to more advanced editing. Cons: The interface can be somewhat confusing for an absolute beginner. Ideal For: Those who want to enhance their skills from a beginner to professional editing. 2. HitFilm Express Features: VFX tools Advanced cutting tools Tons of tutorials. It has a very vast feature set and updates frequently, making it a favorite among video editors. Pros: Some more sophisticated functionalities will require paid-for additional add-ons. Ideal For: Beginners who wish to add visual effects to their videos. 3. Shotcut Features: It supports wide formats, audio and video filters are available, and the interface is quite intuitive. Pros: Open source, cross-platform; for basic editing tasks. Cons: Its interface might look a little old-fashioned. Ideal For: Beginners Looking for a Simple and Effective Editing Tool. 4. OpenShot Features: OpenShot features unlimited layers, an audio waveform, and a very intuitive drag-and-drop interface. Pros: It is very user-friendly and useful for straight projects. Cons: At times, it bugs. Ideal for: Quick, straightforward edits with a minimal learning curve. 5. Lightworks Features: Lightworks offers professional editing tools, multi-cam support, and real-time effects. Pros: It has quality output and is used in professional movie shooting. Cons: The free version has limited exporting options. Ideal For: Those who are looking for an environment that will improve their professional-level editing abilities. 6. iMovie (Mac only) Features: iMovie comes with pre-set templates, trailer creation, and an easy timeline. Pros: Nice integration with macOS; it's quite for beginners. Cons: It's only available for Mac users and has fewer advanced features. Ideal For: Mac users looking for an easy yet effective video editor. 7. Blender Features: Known largely for 3D modeling and rendering, this software also does simple video editing. Pros: Open source, very capable beyond simple video editing. Cons: The disadvantage is that the interface is complex, though mainly used for 3D animation. Ideal for: The individual who is interested in video editing and 3D modeling. 8. VSDC Free Video Editor Features: VSDC provides nonlinear editing, visual and audio effects, and color correction. Pros: It supports multi-formats and is highly feature-rich, so it perfectly works for any editing task. Cons: Interface becomes tricky sometimes. Ideal for: users who require the entire set of editing tools, for bigger projects. 9. Media Composer First by Avid Features: The Avid Professional Tools are multi-camera editing and 4K. Pros: It is a commercial standard software with very quality output options. Cons: The free version does not have sufficient export options. Ideal for: freshers trying to make it in professional video editing. 10. VideoPad Video Editor Features: 3D video editing, a library of sound effects, and pre-made transitions are some of the features offered by VideoPad. Pros: It is light and easy to use, making the editing process quick and straightforward. Cons: It is somewhat lacking in advanced features as in other software. Ideal for: Beginners who want to do a really quick edit or just a basic video project. Choosing the Software that Suits Your Needs There are so many video editing software available. By following some tips, these can be reduced: Project Complexity: If your project is relatively small, you can settle for OpenShot or VideoPad. In case of deeper edits, you will have to look for DaVinci Resolve or Lightworks. System Compatibility: The software should be compatible with the specifications of your computer's operating systems and hardware. Learning Curve: Choose an editing tool that fits your current skill set. The more pleasant and less jarring interfaces one finds in iMovie (for Mac users) or OpenShot are particularly conducive to learning the whole process. How to start Video Editing? Simple video editing Begin with a few fundamental skills: trimming, cutting, and adding transitions to your videos. Practice different types of edits and see what will be helpful for you in the long run. Learning Resources You can learn from web tutorials, courses, and communities to increase your knowledge. YouTube, Udemy, and Coursera would be good websites to learn from people who are beginners. Practice Projects Start with very small projects, practicing the art of editing. Combine clips recorded on your cell phone to make short videos or assemble slideshows from some photos with background music. How to Make Your Videos Pop: Essentials Techniques Include Text and Titles Make your videos engaging and informative by utilizing all sorts of text elements. You can include titles, captions, and lower thirds to highlight all the important details. Transitions and Effects Transitions and effects can make your videos look classy and professional. Use them sparingly so you won't mess and clutter your video visuals. Color Correction Using color grading, your videos will be dramatically more beautiful. You may start with even simple color correction tools like brightness contrast, and saturation. Upgrade to paid versions with time. And then, after you gain some experience, and you want to start doing more sophisticated projects, you might be interested in moving over to paid software. When your project requires features that free software can't deliver, now's the time. Advanced Tools ​ Paid versions come with additional tools and features, like DaVinci Resolve Studio or Adobe Premiere Pro. With Final Cut Pro or Adobe Premiere Pro, industry-standard features and performance can be attained in commercial projects or professional work. Conclusion This is the first step as you embark on your video editing journey from a selection of video editing software. All of the tools mentioned here have unique aspects prepared for the distinctive needs and experience levels. If you would like to create simple home videos or aspire enough to professional editing, free software first can serve as a means to learn it all without the need for significant investment. Remember that continuous learning and practice are the ways through which one will be able to become adequate in video editing. ​If you're looking to take your skills to the next level, check out Jetking’s Master in Gaming and Metaverse Design . This program will help you gain expertise in video editing, 3D modeling, AR/VR, and more opening doors to exciting careers in the digital world! 🚀

title: Top 5 Career for Microsoft Certified Professionals

body.text: Wednesday, September 25, 2024

Introduction Microsoft certifications are highly valued in the tech industry, opening up a variety of career opportunities and validating your expertise in Microsoft technologies. Here are the top 5 career paths for Microsoft Certified Professionals : 1. Cloud Solutions Architect Overview: The demand for Cloud Solutions Architects has surged as companies increasingly move to cloud services. These professionals design, deploy, and manage applications on Microsoft Azure, focusing on scalability, security, and reliability. Key Responsibilities: - Design cloud infrastructure and applications. - Implement cloud solutions. - Manage cloud services. - Ensure cloud security and compliance. Skills Required: - Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure services. - Expertise in cloud architecture and design. - Understanding of networking, virtualization, and storage. Why It’s a Great Career: As more companies shift to the cloud, experts in designing and managing cloud solutions are in high demand. A Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification enhances your job prospects. 2. Data Scientist Overview: Data Scientists analyze data and present insights to help businesses make informed decisions. Microsoft offers certifications to validate your data science skills, particularly with Azure Machine Learning. Key Responsibilities: - Analyze Big Data and produce insights. - Build and deploy machine learning models. - Translate findings for stakeholders. - Utilize Microsoft Azure Machine Learning for predictive modeling. Skills Required: - Proficiency in data analysis and statistical methods. - Knowledge of Python, R, and SQL. - Experience with Microsoft Azure and machine learning tools. Why It’s a Great Career: Data science is a hot field in tech, and the Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate certification showcases your ability to apply data science techniques using Microsoft Azure, opening doors to high-paying job opportunities. 3. DevOps Engineer Overview: DevOps Engineers connect development and operations teams to speed up software delivery. They use various tools and practices to automate the software development process. Key Responsibilities: - Develop CI/CD pipelines. - Automate software and infrastructure deployment. - Monitor system performance. - Maintain security and compliance in software delivery. Skills Required: - Proficiency in scripting languages like PowerShell and Python. - Familiarity with Azure DevOps tools for CI/CD. - Strong understanding of cloud services and infrastructure code. Why It’s a Great Career: DevOps is crucial for agile software development. A Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer certification demonstrates your ability to effectively use Microsoft tools in implementing DevOps practices. 4. System Administrator Overview: System Administrators maintain an organization’s IT infrastructure, ensuring systems run smoothly and securely. Key Responsibilities: - Install and configure servers and networks. - Monitor and troubleshoot system performance. - Manage security and backup activities. - Control user accounts and access. Skills Required: - In-depth knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory. - Experience with Microsoft Azure and Office 365. - Understanding of network protocols and security practices. Why It’s a Great Career Path: Organizations need System Administrators to keep their IT infrastructure in check. Certifications like Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate enhance your skills and reputation. 5. Business Intelligence Analyst Overview: Business Intelligence (BI) Analysts use data to help organizations make better decisions, leveraging various tools for data collection, analysis, and presentation. Key Responsibilities : - Collect and analyze business data. - Use Power BI to create dashboards and reports. - Identify trends to inform strategic decisions. - Collaborate with departments to understand data needs. Skills Required: - Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools, such as Power BI. - Expertise in SQL and data modeling. - Ability to present insights to non-technical stakeholders. Why It’s an Great Career: BI Analysts are essential for data-driven decision-making in organizations. A Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate certification proves your ability to leverage Power BI, making you a valuable asset. Conclusion Microsoft certifications open doors to numerous rewarding careers in technology. From cloud computing and data science to DevOps, system administration, and business intelligence, there are many paths to choose from. By carefully selecting a field and obtaining the right certification, you can enhance your skills and build a successful career in today's rapidly evolving digital landscape. body.text: Monday, May 27, 2024

Introduction ​ Imagine a world in which data isn't stored on actual servers but instead floats effortlessly over a vast digital space that is accessible from any location. Welcome to the world of cloud computing, a game-changing technology that is reshaping the 21st-century digital landscape. There are a ton of exciting career opportunities in this industry due to the growing demand for professionals as more and more companies move their operations to the cloud. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics projects that employment in the cloud computing industry will rise at a rate significantly faster than that of all other occupations. The demand for cloud architects, engineers, developers, and administrators will increase as businesses continue to embrace digital transformation, offering a variety of opportunities for aspiring professionals. What is the meaning of cloud computing? ​ The delivery of computer services such as storage, servers, databases, networking, software, and more through the internet is the basic understanding of cloud computing ("the cloud"). Organizations can grow their operations cost-effectively and flexibly by utilizing cloud services from providers such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and others, instead of maintaining and managing physical infrastructure. Fun Fact: Did you know that the concept of cloud computing was inspired by the symbol used to represent the internet in network diagrams, which resembles a cloud? Top Cloud computing careers Cloud Engineer: To guarantee the dependability and effectiveness of cloud services, cloud engineers develop, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure. They usually have a bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a similar discipline, and they have certifications from Google Cloud, Amazon, or Azure. Cloud engineers can expect to make between $100,000 to $140,000 annually. Cloud Administrator: Account setup, performance monitoring, security assurance, and cloud environment management are all handled by cloud administrators. They typically hold necessary cloud certifications in addition to a bachelor's degree in computer science or information technology. Cloud administrators typically make between $80,000 to $120,000 per year. Cloud Architect: Cloud architects ensure that cloud solutions satisfy corporate needs, cloud architects plan and supervise their deployment. They often hold a master's or bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science, a ton of experience, and certifications like AWS Certified Solutions Architect. The annual salary range for them is $120,000 to $160,000. Cloud Automation Engineer: To optimize operations, these engineers specialize in automating cloud services using tools such as Terraform and Ansible. They usually hold certifications in cloud platforms, expertise in scripting languages, and a bachelor's degree in computer science or a closely related discipline. Cloud automation engineers can expect to make between $100,000 and $140,000 a year. Cloud Consultant: Cloud consultants offer enterprises strategic, tactical, and optimization advice. They typically hold a bachelor's degree in business, computer science, or a similar domain along with numerous professional certifications and in-depth knowledge of clouds. Their annual salary ranges from $90,000 to $150,000. Cloud Data Scientist: To extract insights from massive data stored in the cloud, data scientists use statistical models and machine learning techniques. They usually have expertise with cloud platforms and data analysis tools and hold a bachelor's or master's degree in data science, statistics, or a similar discipline. The yearly salary range for cloud data scientists is $110,000 to $160,000. Cloud Security Analyst: By locating loopholes and putting security measures in place, these analysts make sure cloud settings are secure. Their bachelor's degrees are usually in cybersecurity, computer science, or information technology, and they value certificates such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP). The annual salary range for them is between $90,000 and $130,000. UI Developer: To guarantee a flawless user experience, UI developers design and enhance user interfaces for online applications. Usually, with a bachelor's degree in computer science, graphic design, or a similar discipline, they are skilled in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and frameworks such as Angular or React. UI developers often make between $70,000 and $110,000 per year. Full Stack Developer: Full stack developers oversee the entire development process while working on the front and back ends of web applications. Typically, they hold a bachelor's degree in computer science or a closely related discipline and possess extensive understanding of various programming languages and frameworks. Full stack engineers can expect to make between $90,000 and $130,000 a year in salary. Education Criteria A solid background in computer science, information technology, cyber security etc is usually necessary. Bachelor's degrees in computer science, engineering, or mathematics are commonly held by cloud computing specialists. But Jetking opens the door to the tech world for the students from non tech backgrounds as well. body.text: Thursday, September 22, 2022

From the past, the most desired skill listed by the employers was fluency in English. And with changing times, digital fluency has become one of the top requirements across industries. IoT, machine learning and zillions of apps introduced each day are leading the digital disruption in our age. Also, the impact of such a digital disruption is felt not only in the IT department, but across the entire organization, creating a huge demand for digital skills. Hence, A recent research by Accenture found that in India, men use digital tools to prepare for and find work more frequently than women (81% and 74%, respectively). Yet, the research found that when women and men have the same level of digital proficiency, women are better at leveraging it to find work. While women still lag behind men in digital fluency in all but a handful of countries, improving their digital skills can help bridge gender gap at the workplace. Some of the key skills that men and women need to acquire in order to become digitally fluent and make the workplace a level playing ground are: Mobile skills: Mobile skills to look out for encompass design skills, e.g. platform design, user-interface and gamification. Also, from e-commerce firms to the banking industry, all organizations are hiring app developers to gain a competitive advantage using apps as a platform to connect with their target audience. Hence technical skills such as app development, cloud services and mobile device management are in huge demand. Basics of security: The age of invention and improvement is of the past. At present, organizations are more concerned about hiring security experts who can tighten the security gaps on web and on mobiles to decrease the vulnerability of cyber-attacks. The demand for candidates with good domain knowledge in this field is huge and there is a large imbalance in the supply and demand. Companies have become wary of these threats especially since many now have an online presence and are vulnerable to cyber-attacks. Networking Certifications: With the advancement in technology, organizations need certified network engineers and systems managers to ensure seamless operations across the various platforms that they engage their customers on. Given the amount of investments companies are making in India to enhance their Internet of Things and Cloud infrastructure, candidates with a good understanding of networking will be in much demand. Data Analytics: What doesn’t get measured, doesn’t improve. Far from being just a buzz word, analyzing data to track trends and strategize has become more main stream and the potential for landing a job in this profile is exponentially growing. Consumers have never been more open about sharing their consumption habits and this has led to a substantially voluminous amount of data (pictures, texts, videos, etc.) being churned out for companies to analyze and make sense of. The industry is coming of age, with firms who hire professionals with analytical skills. In a digitally disrupted age, digital transformation is the only way ahead to remain competitive. Hence, bridging the existing digital skills gap is a must. Organizations need to invest in imparting these digital skills to their employees. Government and skilling institutes also need to identify these gaps and bridge them with relevant courses for the working professionals as well for the students. For employees, just acquiring digital skills is not enough. They constantly need to keep updating themselves to stay rust free and recession proof in the ever evolving industries.

title: 5 Questions To Ask Before Joining A Startup
excerpt: India has paved its way to secure the third position in the world in terms of the number of startups – 4200 and counting – with almost three to four new start-u

body.text: Saturday, November 05, 2022

India has paved its way to secure the third position in the world in terms of the number of startups – 4200 and counting – with almost three to four new start-ups popping up every day. Interestingly, 72% of the start-up founders are less than 35 years old; making India home to the youngest entrepreneurs in the world. These statistics may sound promising as start-ups will create employment for many. However, in 2015 we saw a global slowdown which resulted in the crunch for funding for many start-ups which resulted in many shutting shop and mass lay-offs. Hence, it is very important for students to seriously consider various parameters before joining a startup. Here are a few questions students should ask for utmost clarity to ensure they’re not signing up for a raw deal. What’s the product idea? Joining a company with a completely new idea can be risky. Many startups have failed just because they intended to deliver a product or service which had no market demand. You need to ask yourself whether the product really has the potential to go beyond fancy presentations and sell. For this, you may consider looking at its competitors and substitutes as well. How about a background check? There is nothing inappropriate to ask where the funding is coming from in order to take a peek into how well the company will be able to sustain itself. If the company is funded by venture capitalist, you will be able to know who the investors are. A background check on websites like Glassdoor and Payscale will also help you understand the internal issues faced by employees as well as the maximum pay that you can expect over a period of time. Do I fit in? There are a lot of startups which have been cloned from the Western business models. Play, parties, perks and promotions to sum it all. New age startups prefer to hire young people who may or may not have experience. While millennials have their own style of working, would you be able to catch up or would it lead to a clash is something you need to ask. People v/s profits? Getting to know who the founders are and what their visions are helps as many a time companies close down because the founders parted ways with different opinions. While some founders value the man behind the machine others treat the man like a machine! Startups have a close knit team and long working hours too. While profits are important to breakeven for a startup, people are equally important to make as well as sustain profits. So working with a startup and finishing heaps of work but having the flexibility to do it in your comfort zone on a bean bag or at home surely helps. Where do you see yourself in the next five years? Just as an organization’s vision is important to fulfill organizational goals, your vision on where you see yourself in the future is important to fulfill your personal goals. So ask yourself if working with a startup is going to help you to achieve your financial goals, help you grow in the industry, give you job satisfaction and most importantly give you a “nowhere else found learning experience”. While the industry is changing rapidly, doing a SWOT analysis (strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats) with the aid of these questions will surely help you make the right decision. Yes, mistakes do happen. But at the end, it’s all about being able to join the dots and maybe joining a startup could be one such bold dot in your career graph leading to greater opportunities.

title: Digital Skilling for the Digitally Disrupted Age
excerpt: From the past, the most desired skill listed by the employers was fluency in English. And with changing times, digital fluency has become one of the top requir

body.text: Saturday, November 05, 2022

From the past, the most desired skill listed by the employers was fluency in English. And with changing times, digital fluency has become one of the top requirements across industries. IoT, machine learning and zillions of apps introduced each day are leading the digital disruption in our age. Also, the impact of such a digital disruption is felt not only in the IT department, but across the entire organization, creating a huge demand for digital skills. Hence, A recent research by Accenture found that in India, men use digital tools to prepare for and find work more frequently than women (81% and 74%, respectively). Yet, the research found that when women and men have the same level of digital proficiency, women are better at leveraging it to find work. While women still lag behind men in digital fluency in all but a handful of countries, improving their digital skills can help bridge gender gap at the workplace. Some of the key skills that men and women need to acquire in order to become digitally fluent and make the workplace a level playing ground are: Mobile skills: Mobile skills to look out for encompass design skills, e.g. platform design, user-interface and gamification. Also, from e-commerce firms to the banking industry, all organizations are hiring app developers to gain a competitive advantage using apps as a platform to connect with their target audience. Hence technical skills such as app development, cloud services and mobile device management are in huge demand. Basics of security: The age of invention and improvement is of the past. At present, organizations are more concerned about hiring security experts who can tighten the security gaps on web and on mobiles to decrease the vulnerability of cyber-attacks. The demand for candidates with good domain knowledge in this field is huge and there is a large imbalance in the supply and demand. Companies have become wary of these threats especially since many now have an online presence and are vulnerable to cyber-attacks. Networking Certifications: With the advancement in technology, organizations need certified network engineers and systems managers to ensure seamless operations across the various platforms that they engage their customers on. Given the amount of investments companies are making in India to enhance their Internet of Things and Cloud infrastructure, candidates with a good understanding of networking will be in much demand.

Data Analytics: What doesn’t get measured, doesn’t improve. Far from being just a buzz word, analyzing data to track trends and strategize has become more main stream and the potential for landing a job in this profile is exponentially growing. Consumers have never been more open about sharing their consumption habits and this has led to a substantially voluminous amount of data (pictures, texts, videos, etc.) being churned out for companies to analyze and make sense of. The industry is coming of age, with firms who hire professionals with analytical skills. In a digitally disrupted age, digital transformation is the only way ahead to remain competitive. Hence, bridging the existing digital skills gap is a must. Organizations need to invest in imparting these digital skills to their employees. Government and skilling institutes also need to identify these gaps and bridge them with relevant courses for the working professionals as well for the students. For employees, just acquiring digital skills is not enough. They constantly need to keep updating themselves to stay rust free and recession proof in the ever evolving industries.

title: 10 Ways to Reduce Your Stress
excerpt: 10 Ways to Reduce Your Stress

body.text: Sunday, May 14, 2023

Due to the fast-paced lives we lead, stress has become an inseparable part of our existence. But, too much stress can have a bad effect on our physical and mental health. Stress is a natural reaction of our body that makes our body to react according to the situation and decide whether to fight or flight. It prepares the body for potential threats and new atmosphere by either motivating or slowing down the activity of various body systems. Minimizing stress often starts by altering our mind-set and point of view towards life. This is the very basic rule of stress management. These 10 efficient ways which we are going to discuss in this article will surely help you get rid of the stress and develop a vigorous attitude towards life’s problems which lead to stress. 1. Avoid Making Decisions when You are Angry: Many of us tend to make impulsive decisions when we are annoyed. Arguing with someone when we are annoyed or angry in turn leads to more stress that could lead to a swarm of unwanted problems. Only make decisions when you are calm, cool and ostensibly balanced. When your mind has had the chance to reduce your stress, you will find it much convenient to take the correct decisions. 2. Try Not to Worry All the Time: Obsessing persistently about something isn’t going to help it give you a good result for sure. Worrying neither helps you gain control over a fussy condition nor does help you handle them, and worse is that it further adds to your stress. It is very natural and true that when you worry about a situation, you start to imagine the worst, and begin thinking more negatively. This course of worrying turns into a consistent habit and the next thing you know, you are dealing with chronic stress. Your mind is in fact the real key where you can get rid of the stress find the solution to all your problems. 3. Cut Yourself Some Slack: Try not to be too hard and pressing on yourself. Many of tend to hold ourselves up to a much higher standard, this ends up causing a lot of stress because they develop a feeling that they need to live up to that standard, and when they couldn’t meet up with that standard they begin to get stressed. So, the best practice to keep yourself away from this type of stress is to, trying not to judge yourself for things which are out of your control, and keeping a close watch on your emotions. If you feel that something is wrong and you are getting stressed, take a step back and assess the situation, try to divert your mind towards the best thing you have or something you love the most. Next, try and find the positive side in every condition that you are in. Finally, be more considerate towards yourself and you will find that you are a more self-confident, successful, relieved and happy person. 4. Practice Meditation: One of the best and efficient ways to minimize stress is to practice meditation or diaphragmatic breathing (Anulom-Vilom). It also helps to rid your body of strain and twinge. Meditation helps to calm your mind and focus your brain on better things and divert your thoughts on positive aspects of life. Breathing exercises stimulate your nervous system, and advance the flow of lymph, which is rich in immune cells. Sit in a comfortable place in your home, place your hands on your stomach and chest and focus on your breathing. Take deep breaths and release them with force, experience your stomach rising and falling with each breath. This relaxing breathing exercise will certainly help ease your stress, it’s a tried and test technique. 5. Understand Your Feelings: Try listening to what your emotions are trying to tell you, when you are more receptive to your own feelings, you will extensively be able to perk up your life. Not only will this help you ease your nervousness and stress, but will also help balance your physical and emotional health and keep it in sync with your mind. You should never suppress your feelings as it might have negative effects on your mind and body and it could also wreck your social life. 6. Process Your Feelings: Knowing how to process your feelings is one of the most essential areas of mental development. Do not let your feelings stay back in your head, take out some time every day to process your feelings. If you’re not sure how to do this, take a notepad and a pen and jot down everything you are feeling and all the fuming thoughts you are having, this exercise will help you to figure out ideas on how you can combat them. This way, you will yourself find out a way to relieve yourself from the anxiety and stress. 7. Laugh More Often: You might have heard people saying “Laughter is the best medicine,” and this is fairly true! Laughing induces positive physical changes in your body and provides considerable muscle relaxation which releases stress from your mind, improves your blood circulation, and provides a good exercise to your whole abdomen. Humor helps you cheer up your mood and fight anxiety, depression and stress. 8. Accept things You Can’t Control: “What can’t be cured, must be endured.” When you learn to accept that a few things just can’t be controlled or changed, you will be a happier and carefree man. It can be difficult to feel helpless, but there is no point getting obsessed on things that are out of your control. In contrast, you should always focus on changing the things that you can change, and believe that this approach will help you develop a positive attitude towards life and reduce your stress significantly. 9. Be Thankful for all you Have: Another great way to reduce stress is to improve your health with a dose of appreciation. However, it is complicated to have a positive attitude when life seems to be getting you down, but it isn’t impossible. Try finding the things that you are grateful for, doesn’t matter if they are small or seem insignificant, they should be able to offer you on the whole life satisfaction. When you nurture gratitude as part of your life, you can not only perk up your emotional sense of happiness, but also experience a superior sense of contentment. 10. Do things that Make You Happy: Take out time to do those things that make you really happy. Grab some dinner with a friend, watch a movie, play with your kids, read a book, go cycling, take a long walk with your loved ones or go shopping, do whatever you want to do to make yourself happy. When you are happy, your mood is always good and stress, anxiety, anger all these things seems like a million miles away. If you have any other suggestion you want to share with us please feel free to comment below
